title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are a regional company with a team of approximately 40 employees across Singapore, Korea, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our business operates across multiple markets, with teams supporting various business and operational functions.



We are looking for a proactive and independent Talent Acquisition Specialist who can manage regional recruitment while developing and improving efficient recruitment processes and systems.



This role will report directly to the CEO.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Regional Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

- Manage end-to-end recruitment across Singapore, Malaysia and the Philippines, including job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, initial interviews, interview coordination, and offer follow-ups.

- Coordinate with hiring managers across different countries to understand staffing needs, job requirements, and hiring priorities.

- Identify and utilize suitable recruitment platforms and sourcing strategies for each market.

- Manage multiple vacancies simultaneously and ensure timely candidate follow-ups throughout the hiring process.

- Conduct initial candidate interviews and provide recommendations to hiring managers based on candidate suitability.

- Coordinate job offers and onboarding handovers with the HR team.



2. Recruitment Process & System Improvement

- Independently design, implement, and continuously improve recruitment processes and workflows across regional teams.

- Develop and maintain centralized recruitment tracking systems and candidate databases using Google Sheets, Google Forms, ATS, or other suitable tools.

- Standardize recruitment workflows, including screening questionnaires, interview evaluation forms, hiring stages, and approval processes.

- Build and maintain a searchable database of previous applicants for future recruitment needs.

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive recruitment tasks and improve hiring efficiency.

- Develop recruitment SOPs, templates, and guidelines to ensure consistent recruitment practices across different countries.



3. Recruitment Reporting & Coordination

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment pipelines across all active vacancies.

- Prepare weekly recruitment reports, including hiring progress, candidate pipelines, recruitment KPIs, and outstanding actions.

- Monitor recruitment performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements.

- Follow up with hiring managers to ensure timely feedback and hiring decisions.

- Support other recruitment-related administrative duties as required.





Qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree, Advanced Diploma, or Diploma in Human Resource Management, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.

- 3–5 years of proven experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment, preferably supporting multiple vacancies and international teams.

- Experience recruiting across Singapore, Malaysia or other international markets is highly preferred.

- Proven ability to independently manage recruitment processes, from sourcing to offer coordination.

- Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, including formulas, tracking systems, candidate databases, and reporting.

- Proficient with Google Workspace tools (Docs, Forms, Calendar, Gmail, and Chat).

- Experience using recruitment platforms such as JobStreet, LinkedIn, OnlineJobs.ph, and other job portals.

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.





Preferred:

- Experience independently developing or improving recruitment workflows, tracking systems, or ATS implementation.

- Familiarity with recruitment automation tools such as Google Apps Script, Zapier, or Make.

- Experience recruiting for retail, FMCG, e-commerce, distribution, or operational roles.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple vacancies and deadlines.

- Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership, and proactively recommend improvements.

- Experience working with international teams and hiring managers.

- High level of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism when handling candidate information.





Benefits:

- Structured salary increase and promotion based on performance.

- Leave benefits and public holidays.



**THIS IS A FULL-TIME CONTRACTOR ROLE | CONTRACTOR HANDLES THEIR OWN STATUTORY FILINGS.**

title: General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer
description:
General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer  



Remote | Philippines-Based | Monday to Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm AEST



**To Apply** 



The General Insurance Claims & Administration Officer will provide claims and administrative support to a well-established general insurance broking firm in the Australian market. The role is primarily claims-focused: working under the direction of the Claims Consultant, you will help progress general insurance claims accurately and promptly through claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, and record maintenance. 



Alongside claims, the role provides policy-servicing and general administrative support to the broking team to keep the brokerage running smoothly day to day. 





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



** Claims Support **  



Claims Lodgements 

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge new general insurance claims accurately and promptly through insurer portals and systems, in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions 

- Accurately record client issues, claim details, and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM 



Insurer and Claims Follow-Up 

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims, including making follow-up calls and remaining on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps 

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue 

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes 

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant 



Documentation and Information Requests 

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, repair or replacement information, and any other documentation required by the insurer 

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant, and report progress on outstanding documentation 

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system 



Claims Administration 

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records 

- Diary and action follow-ups to keep claims progressing 

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultant 

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly 

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant 





** Policy Servicing and Administrative Support **

 

- Manage and service an existing portfolio of clients across Builders Warranty and Construction policies, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Prepare quotes, policy documentation, renewals, endorsements, amendments, and cancellations 

- Assist brokers with assessing client needs and sourcing, negotiating, and placing suitable insurance policies with insurers 

- Maintain and update client databases, policy records, and CRM documentation accurately and promptly 

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the broking team, including data entry, filing, and document management 

- Handle and liaise with insurers on behalf of clients on policy and servicing matters 

- Manage client enquiries professionally and efficiently through the firm’s approved communication channels 

- Build and maintain professional working relationships with clients and insurers, within the role’s defined authority 

- Identify and refer appropriate upsell or cross-sell opportunities to the broking team 

- Follow industry regulations, internal procedures, and documentation standards 

- Support the team with ad-hoc administrative tasks and projects as required 





SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 



You Must Have 

- 3 - 4 years of administrative or office support experience in general insurance, working for an Australian-based insurance broker 

- Hands-on experience in general insurance claims lodgement and claims management (not life, health, or superannuation) 

- Familiarity with general insurance terminology and insurer portals. 

- Well organised and highly motivated, with strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple clients, and meet deadlines 

- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment 

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach 

- Confident negotiation and problem-solving abilities 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint 

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team 



Nice to have

- Experience using Insight or Office Tech broking systems 

- Experience managing or servicing Builders Warranty and Construction policy portfolios, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Understanding of insurance products, policy wordings, and risk assessment 

- Proficiency with insurance broking systems 

- Tier 1 RG146 qualification 





**To Apply**

title: AU Asset Finance
description:
Asset Finance Support



Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



To Apply, please submit this form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/1MQsTx8TQa



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Be Doing Every Day

Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention



You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements

Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have

Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer

Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: Australian Insurance Claims Support Officer
description:
Claims Support Officer



Remote | Philippines-Based | AEST Hour

 

**To Apply** 

 

The Claims Support Officer will provide administrative support to the Claims Consultant and help progress insurance claims accurately and promptly. Working under the Claims Consultant’s direction, the role will assist with claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, record maintenance, and general claims administration for an Australian insurance broking firm.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 



Claims Lodgements 

- Assist the Claims Consultant with lodging new insurance claims 

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge claims accurately and promptly in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions 

- Record claim details and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM 



 Insurer and Claims Follow-Up 

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims 

- Make follow-up calls and remain on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps 

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue 

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes 

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant 



 Documentation and Information Requests 

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant 

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, and repair or replacement information 

- Follow up outstanding documentation and report progress to the Claims Consultant 

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system 



 Claims Administration 

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records 

- Diary and action follow-ups to help keep claims progressing 

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultantz

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly 

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant 





REPORTING STRUCTURE AND ROLE BOUNDARIES 



The Claims Support Officer reports directly to the Claims Consultant and performs all duties under their direction. This is primarily an administrative and support-based role. 



- The role does not independently manage client relationships, provide claims advice, or make decisions on behalf of the broker or Claims Consultant 

- All client-facing matters and substantive claims discussions remain the responsibility of the Claims Consultant 

- Client or third-party follow-ups must be limited to the specific tasks and instructions provided by the Claims Consultant 



 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 



You Must Have 

- Previous experience in administration, claims support, insurance support, or a similarly process-driven role 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling claim information and documentation 

- Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to monitor multiple follow-ups and deadlines 

- Clear and professional communication skills, including confidence contacting insurers and other parties for factual updates and outstanding information 

- Ability to follow detailed instructions, work within defined authority, and escalate issues appropriately 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM and claims-management systems

- Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and work full-time during Australian business hours, Monday to Friday 



Nice to Have 

- Experience working for an insurance brokerage or general insurer 

- Previous exposure to insurance claims lodgement and claims administration 

- Experience communicating with insurers, claims teams, loss assessors, or repairers and using insurance, claims, or CRM systems 

- Basic understanding of the general insurance claims lifecycle and its common documentation





**To Apply**

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Long-Form YouTube Editor for On-Location Tours & Talking Heads
description:
HOW TO APPLY

Start with a direct link to one complete, published 15–30 minute YouTube video you personally edited. Pick a video where a host moves through a location and talks on camera. A home tour, travel vlog, neighborhood guide, or similar on-location video works. Include a timestamp from the middle and one sentence explaining what you edited. Then share your expected monthly rate and confirm your weekly availability and ability to handle the deliverables below. A reel or general portfolio can be included as a second link.



ABOUT THE CHANNEL

I’m a real estate agent building Living on the Alabama Gulf Coast, a YouTube channel for people relocating to Baldwin County, Alabama. I film host-led home and community tours, relocation videos, and talking heads. Experience with real estate is welcome. Your sample can come from another niche if it shows the same on-camera storytelling and pacing.



WEEKLY DELIVERABLES

• Two long-form YouTube edits, typically 15–30 minutes for tours and 10–20 minutes for talking heads

• Two thumbnails, one per video

• About two short clips repurposed from the finished videos



EDITING STYLE AND WORKFLOW

Keep my delivery conversational. Cut repeated takes and distracting pauses, maintain the flow as I move through a location, and use supplied close-ups and local B-roll to show what I’m talking about. Add clear text or map graphics where useful, balance dialogue and music, correct color, and work from organized footage in Google Drive. I’ll provide footage, style references, and feedback.



COMPENSATION

Remote, part-time, long-term. Budget is $800–$1,100 USD per month for about 20–25 hours per week, depending on experience and agreed scope. We’ll start with a short paid editing test using my footage.

title: U.S. Bookkeeper / QuickBooks Cleanup Specialist
description:
# U.S. Bookkeeper / QuickBooks Cleanup Specialist



**Location:** Philippines — Remote  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Project-Based  

**Compensation:** $4-$6 USD/hour, depending on experience  

**Initial Workload:** Approximately 10–20 hours per week, depending on project needs  

**Start:** As soon as practical



## About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur seeking an experienced bookkeeper to reconstruct and organize my 2026 financial records and establish a reliable bookkeeping system.



I operate multiple business activities, including service-based work and a growing digital lead-generation business.



My immediate priority is to establish accurate income, expense, and financial records that can be used by a U.S. tax accountant for year-end planning and tax preparation.



I am looking for someone who can independently organize messy financial information, identify discrepancies, reconcile accounts, and produce accurate financial reports.



**This is a hands-on bookkeeping and financial reconstruction role—not a virtual assistant or data-entry position.**



## Primary Responsibilities



**1. Financial Reconstruction & Cleanup**



- Review and organize 2026 bank statements, transaction exports, receipts, and financial records.

- Categorize business income and expenses.

- Reconcile bank and credit-card transactions.

- Identify missing records, duplicate transactions, and inconsistencies.

- Separate personal and business transactions.

- Maintain separate financial records for different business activities.

- Prepare an organized list of questionable transactions requiring clarification.



**2. QuickBooks & Accounting**



- Set up or clean up QuickBooks Online, as appropriate.

- Establish a practical chart of accounts.

- Import and categorize transactions.

- Reconcile accounts to supporting statements.

- Prepare profit-and-loss statements.

- Prepare balance sheets where applicable.

- Produce income and expense summaries.

- Maintain organized supporting documentation.



**3. Tax Preparation Support**



- Prepare clean financial reports for a U.S. tax professional.

- Identify potentially deductible business expenses for professional review.

- Separate different categories of service income.

- Organize documents needed for tax filing.

- Coordinate with a U.S. tax accountant when necessary.

- Maintain clear records of assumptions and unresolved issues.



You are not expected to independently determine complex U.S. tax treatment or provide legal or tax advice.



**4. Ongoing Bookkeeping**



If the initial project is successful, responsibilities may expand to monthly bookkeeping, financial reporting, contractor payment tracking, and accounting support for a growing digital business.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong hands-on QuickBooks Online experience.

- Demonstrated bank and credit-card reconciliation experience.

- Experience cleaning up incomplete or disorganized accounting records.

- Ability to prepare accurate financial statements.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Experience working with U.S. businesses or U.S. accounting practices.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Clear written English communication.

- Ability to work independently and identify problems without constant supervision.



## Preferred Qualifications



- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.

- Accounting degree or equivalent professional training.

- Experience preparing books for U.S. tax accountants.

- Familiarity with sole proprietorships and Schedule C accounting.

- Experience with multiple business activities.

- Experience with historical bookkeeping reconstruction.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted accounting workflows, with appropriate data security.



## Ideal Candidate



I value someone who is accurate, organized, resourceful, and proactive.



You should be comfortable working with imperfect financial records, identifying missing information, and asking intelligent questions.



I am not looking for someone who simply categorizes transactions without understanding the underlying accounting.



**Your goal is to deliver clean, reconciled, reliable books—not merely complete a list of tasks.**



## Initial Project



The first engagement will focus on reconstructing 2026 financial records.



Expected deliverables include:



- Reconciled financial records.

- Organized transaction classifications.

- Separate income and expense reports by business activity.

- Preliminary financial statements.

- A list of missing information and unresolved issues.

- A tax-accountant-ready financial package.

- Recommendations for maintaining accurate records going forward.



The initial engagement will be paid and scoped according to the volume and condition of the records.



Long-term opportunities may be available based on performance.



## Application Instructions — Read Carefully



To demonstrate that you have read the complete posting, begin your application with the exact heading:



**Bookkeeping Cleanup — Application**



Then provide:



1. Your résumé and a brief summary of your bookkeeping experience.

2. Your QuickBooks Online experience and any certifications.

3. One example of a bookkeeping cleanup or financial reconstruction project you personally completed.

4. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

5. Your experience preparing financial records for U.S. tax accountants.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer in approximately 100–150 words:



*A U.S. sole proprietor has three business activities, several bank accounts, mixed personal and business transactions, and incomplete bookkeeping records for 2026.*



**What are the first five steps you would take to reconstruct accurate financial records, and how would you verify the results?**



We are evaluating your practical accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You may include a short 2–3 minute video introducing yourself, explaining your bookkeeping experience, and describing a cleanup project you personally completed.



A simple recording is sufficient. Video is preferred but not required; written responses are equally acceptable.



## Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short, paid practical assessment using fictional financial data.



The assessment may involve transaction categorization, reconciliation, identifying discrepancies, and preparing a basic financial report.



Please do not submit confidential client financial records.



We are looking for a dependable professional who can establish accurate books and help build a reliable long-term accounting system.

title: U.S. Tax Accountant – Tax Preparation & Planning
description:
# U.S. Tax Accountant / Tax Preparation Specialist



**Location:** Philippines — Remote  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Project-Based  

**Compensation:** $4-$8 USD/hour, depending on experience and qualifications  

**Initial Workload:** Approximately 5–15 hours per week, depending on project needs  

**Start:** As soon as practical



## About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur seeking an experienced U.S. tax accountant to help establish my current tax position, identify legitimate tax-planning opportunities, and prepare accurate tax documentation.



My business activities currently operate primarily as sole proprietorships, and I am developing a scalable digital lead-generation business.



I need someone with genuine hands-on U.S. federal tax experience who can work with organized financial records, identify missing information, prepare tax projections, and support compliance and planning decisions.



**This is a technical U.S. tax accounting position—not a general bookkeeping or virtual assistant role.**



I may also engage specialized U.S. tax and legal professionals for matters requiring additional expertise.



## Primary Responsibilities



**1. U.S. Individual & Small-Business Tax Accounting**



- Review financial records and supporting documentation.

- Assist with Form 1040 and Schedule C tax preparation.

- Calculate or support self-employment tax projections.

- Identify potential business deductions and applicable limitations.

- Review income and expense classifications.

- Prepare tax workpapers and supporting schedules.

- Assist with federal and California tax calculations.

- Identify missing documentation and potential compliance issues.



**2. Tax Projections & Year-End Planning**



- Prepare preliminary current-year federal and state tax projections.

- Compare tax outcomes under different legitimate planning scenarios.

- Evaluate estimated tax payments and relevant deadlines.

- Identify available deductions and retirement contribution opportunities.

- Analyze the potential tax impact of planned business expenditures.

- Prepare concise summaries of findings and recommendations.



All conclusions must be supported by applicable rules, documented assumptions, and appropriate professional review.



**3. Retirement & Business Tax Research**



Assist with research and preliminary analysis involving:



- Solo 401(k) contributions.

- Traditional and Roth retirement accounts.

- Self-employment tax.

- Qualified business income deductions.

- Business depreciation.

- S-Corp and C-Corp taxation.

- Entity elections and transitions.

- Other relevant small-business tax strategies.



Specialized arrangements such as ROBS, complex trusts, and international structures may require outside experts.



You are not expected to independently provide legal opinions or specialized advice beyond your qualifications.



**4. Tax Compliance & Professional Coordination**



- Organize tax documentation for filing.

- Help determine which previous tax years require review.

- Coordinate with bookkeepers and outside tax professionals.

- Prepare questions for specialist consultations.

- Maintain a list of unresolved tax issues.

- Track tax-related deadlines and documentation requirements.

- Support implementation of professionally reviewed recommendations.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation experience.

- Experience preparing Form 1040 and Schedule C returns.

- Experience with U.S. business tax returns or related workpapers.

- Strong understanding of U.S. individual and small-business taxation.

- Ability to calculate or prepare tax projections.

- Familiarity with self-employment tax and business deductions.

- Experience using professional U.S. tax preparation software.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to research tax questions using authoritative sources.

- Clear written English communication.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Active IRS Enrolled Agent or U.S. CPA credential.

- Philippine CPA qualification with substantial U.S. tax experience.

- Experience working for a U.S. CPA firm.

- Experience with California individual and small-business tax returns.

- Familiarity with retirement contribution calculations.

- Experience with Forms 1120-S, 1065, or 1120.

- Experience supporting tax-planning engagements.

- Familiarity with QuickBooks Online.

- Experience communicating directly with U.S. clients.



Please identify the jurisdiction and current status of any professional credentials.



## Ideal Candidate



I am looking for someone who understands tax rules rather than merely entering information into tax software.



You should be capable of:



- Identifying missing facts before calculating tax liabilities.

- Recognizing potentially valuable deductions.

- Explaining tax-planning alternatives.

- Supporting conclusions with reliable sources.

- Recognizing when specialized advice is required.

- Communicating technical issues clearly.

- Working independently without overstating your expertise.



**Accuracy, professional judgment, and intellectual honesty are essential.**



## Initial Project



The first engagement will focus on establishing my current tax position and preparing for year-end planning and filing.



Expected deliverables include:



- Preliminary federal and California tax projections.

- Identification of missing information.

- Review of potential deductions.

- Retirement contribution calculations where applicable.

- Review of estimated tax obligations.

- Identification of prior-year filing questions.

- A prioritized tax-action checklist.

- Organized documentation for tax return preparation and professional review.



The scope and deadlines will be established at the beginning of the engagement.



Successful candidates may be considered for recurring tax accounting and compliance support.



## Application Instructions — Read Carefully



To demonstrate that you have reviewed the complete posting, begin your application with the exact heading:



**U.S. Tax Accounting — Application**



Then provide:



1. Your résumé and years of hands-on U.S. tax experience.

2. The U.S. tax forms you have personally prepared or reviewed.

3. The tax software you have used professionally.

4. One example of a tax-planning calculation or analysis you personally completed.

5. Your credentials, hourly rate, and weekly availability.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer in approximately 100–150 words:



*A California sole proprietor reports approximately $140,000 in annual business income and has no existing retirement accounts. The owner wants to reduce current-year taxes while preserving cash for a growing business.*



**What information would you request before calculating the owner's tax liability, and which three tax-planning opportunities would you investigate first?**



We are evaluating technical understanding, analytical reasoning, and recognition of missing information—not promises of a particular tax outcome.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You may include a short 2–3 minute video introducing yourself, describing your U.S. tax experience, and explaining a tax calculation or planning project you personally completed.



A simple recording is sufficient. Video is preferred but not required; equivalent written responses are welcome.



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete a paid practical assessment using fictional tax and financial data.



The assessment may include reviewing a sample Schedule C, preparing a basic tax projection, identifying missing information, and researching a technical tax question.



Applicants should not submit confidential client tax records.



We are looking for a technically capable professional who can help establish accurate tax information and support sound financial decisions.

Our mission is to identify winning products, create high-converting storefronts, and drive scalable traffic through paid advertising and automated fulfillment systems.



We are seeking a Shopify Dropshipping Expert who can manage the full lifecycle of dropshipping stores—from product research and supplier sourcing to paid ads management and scaling performance.



Responsibilities

Product Research & Supplier Sourcing



Identify trending, high-demand products suitable for Shopify dropshipping.



Source and vet reliable suppliers (AliExpress, private agents, wholesalers, etc.).



Ensure competitive pricing, shipping times, and product quality standards.



Shopify Store Setup & Product Listings



Build and optimize Shopify product pages with persuasive copy, pricing, and visuals.



Implement upsells, bundles, and conversion-focused layouts.



Manage product imports, variants, and inventory settings.



Paid Ads Management (Meta / TikTok / Google)



Launch, manage, and optimize paid ad campaigns for dropshipping products.



Test creatives, audiences, hooks, and offers to find winning combinations.



Scale profitable campaigns while maintaining target CPA/ROAS.



Monitor ad performance and adjust budgets and targeting accordingly.



Automation & Fulfillment Management



Implement and manage dropshipping apps and integrations (DSers, AutoDS, CJ, etc.).



Ensure seamless order routing, tracking updates, and supplier sync.



Oversee order fulfillment flow and resolve supplier or shipping issues.



Store Scaling & Conversion Optimization



Optimize product pages, offers, and pricing to maximize conversion rate and AOV.



Test bundles, upsells, landing pages, and promotions.



Identify winning products and scale across stores.



Performance Monitoring & Reporting



Track KPIs including revenue, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, and margins.



Provide weekly reports and growth recommendations.



Monitor product performance and discontinue underperformers.



Collaboration



Work with creative teams to produce ad creatives and UGC-style content.



Align product and advertising strategy across campaigns and stores.



Support internal teams and clients with Shopify dropshipping best practices.



Requirements



Proven experience running Shopify dropshipping stores and paid ads.



Strong product research and supplier sourcing experience.



Experience managing Meta, TikTok, or Google e-commerce ad campaigns.



Familiarity with dropshipping tools (DSers, AutoDS, Zendrop, CJdropshipping, etc.).



Understanding of conversion optimization and funnel performance.



Ability to analyze store and ad metrics to scale winning products.



Strong organization and communication skills.

title: # Account Manager — Client Management & Slack Coordination
description:
**Type:** Contractor

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time business hours

**Compensation:** $500–$700/month, depending on experience



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and **extremely responsive Account Manager** to join our marketing/web agency.



This is primarily an **ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT and CLIENT COMMUNICATION position.**



You will manage multiple client accounts, communicate with clients, stay closely connected with our internal team, follow up on outstanding items, and make sure nothing gets forgotten or left sitting unanswered.



## THIS ROLE REQUIRES EXTREME FOLLOW-THROUGH



We are looking for someone who is naturally **persistent, detail-oriented, and proactive.**



If someone tells you:



> "I'll get back to you tomorrow."



You don't simply forget about it.



You remember it, follow up, check the status, and keep following up until the issue is resolved.



You should be the type of person who notices:



* "Nobody responded to this client yet."

* "This task is still waiting."

* "The developer hasn't updated us."

* "The client is waiting for an answer."

* "We said we'd follow up today."

* "This project needs attention."



And then **you take action without somebody having to tell you.**



## SLACK IS A MAJOR PART OF THIS JOB



You must be extremely comfortable working in **Slack throughout the workday.**



You will need to stay active and responsive in Slack, monitor conversations, communicate with the internal team, follow up on tasks, and make sure important messages do not get lost.



You should be comfortable with a work environment where you may be communicating with multiple people and handling multiple conversations at the same time.



**You need to be highly responsive and consistently available during your agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time working hours.**



This is not a position where you check Slack once every few hours.



You need to be **actively engaged throughout the workday.**



## CLIENT ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT



You will work with multiple clients and will be responsible for making sure they feel that their account is being actively managed.



Your responsibilities include:



* Responding to client messages

* Following up with clients

* Keeping clients updated

* Understanding what clients need

* Making sure client requests reach the right team member

* Following up internally for answers

* Following up on outstanding work

* Making sure clients don't have to repeatedly chase us

* Keeping track of open issues and requests

* Making sure commitments and follow-ups are not forgotten

* Maintaining a professional and positive client relationship



You will also work with one particular client who requires **especially strong account-management skills and frequent communication.**



This client is very involved and expects a high level of attention and responsiveness.



You must be comfortable working with a demanding client while remaining calm, professional, friendly, and persistent.



## WORKING WITH THE INTERNAL TEAM



You will communicate with developers, designers, marketers, and other team members.



You do **not** need to be a programmer or developer.



You are **not being hired to write code.**



You simply need enough familiarity with digital/web agency work to understand conversations and communicate effectively with the team.



Your primary responsibility is to **coordinate, communicate, follow up, and keep things moving.**



For example:



> "The client is waiting for an update. Can you please let me know the status?"



If there is no response:



> "Just following up on this — the client is waiting for an update."



And if necessary:



> "I need an update on this today so we can respond to the client."



You should not be afraid to **follow up repeatedly and respectfully until something gets done.**



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal person is:



* Extremely organized

* Highly responsive

* Persistent

* Proactive

* Detail-oriented

* Excellent at follow-up

* Comfortable managing many conversations

* Excellent with clients

* Comfortable dealing with demanding personalities

* Good at keeping track of small details

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable taking ownership

* Comfortable being persistent with coworkers when something needs to get done

* Excellent written and spoken English



### You may be a good fit if you are the type of person who:



**Doesn't let things fall through the cracks.**



**Doesn't need to be reminded to follow up.**



**Notices when someone hasn't responded.**



**Keeps asking until an issue is resolved.**



**Likes keeping everything organized and under control.**



## EXPERIENCE



Previous experience in any of the following is helpful:



* Account Management

* Client Success

* Customer Success

* Project Coordination

* Agency Account Management

* Marketing Agency

* Web Agency

* Digital Agency

* Operations Coordination

* Client Services



Experience working in a marketing or web agency is preferred, but **strong account-management and client-service experience may also be considered.**



Technical programming knowledge is **not required**.



## TOOLS



Experience with:



* **Slack — very important**

* ClickUp or Monday

* Google Workspace

* WordPress



Slack experience is particularly important because this position requires you to be **actively engaged in Slack throughout the workday.**



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer these **4 questions**:



**1. Tell us about your previous experience in Account Management, Client Success, Customer Success, Project Coordination, or a similar role.**



**2. How many clients or accounts were you responsible for at the same time, and how did you keep track of everything that needed your attention?**



**3. Tell us about a time when you had to repeatedly follow up with someone internally to get something completed for a client. What did you do?**



**4. How much experience do you have using Slack? Please explain how you used Slack in your previous work and how frequently you were expected to be active and responsive.**



Please provide specific examples rather than simply answering yes or no.



## COMPENSATION



**$500–$700 USD per month**, depending on experience and qualifications.



Please include your **desired monthly compensation** in your application.



## INTERVIEW INFORMATION



We will conduct **short online interviews on September 30, 2026, Eastern Time.**



The exact interview time is **not finalized yet due to my schedule.**



There are two ways to receive an interview:



### OPTION 1 — FOLLOW THIS JOB POST



I will update this post with the **Google Meet interview time and meeting link** once the schedule is finalized.



If you are interested, follow the post and check for the update.



GOOGLE MEET INTERVIEW



Google Meet Link:







Interview Time:



starting at 1:40 pm EST



will be open for about an hour



Please use the Google Meet link above to join at your scheduled interview time.



You may be placed in the waiting room when you join. I will be interviewing candidates one at a time, so please wait until I admit you to the meeting.



If you are unexpectedly disconnected or removed from the meeting, please simply rejoin using the same Google Meet link. This can sometimes happen automatically due to Google Meet's system, and it is not intentional.



AFTER YOUR INTERVIEW



After completing your interview, please send me a message through the OnlineJobs.ph portal letting me know that you completed the interview and would like to follow up regarding the position.



I will review the interviews and applications and personally contact candidates whom I believe are a good fit for the position.



Thank you, and I look forward to speaking with you!



### OPTION 2 — APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH



Submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph.



If I review your application and would like to interview you, **I will send you a message with your specific interview time and Google Meet link.**



If you receive an interview invitation, you must be available at the scheduled time.





The interview will be short and will focus on your experience, communication style, organization, follow-through, and ability to handle real client situations.



We are looking for someone interested in a **long-term working relationship** who will take genuine ownership of client accounts.

title: Graphic Designer | Brand Identity & Presentations
description:
**About Us**



We're a small, creative team based in Los Angeles, working across entertainment, production, wellness, beauty, and emerging brands.



We're looking for a talented, versatile graphic designer to collaborate with us on a variety of projects, with a strong emphasis on **designing pitch decks, presentations, and creative treatments**, alongside brand identities, product concepts, packaging, and marketing materials.



Presentation design will be a significant and consistent part of this role, so we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys turning ideas, information, and visual references into beautifully designed, compelling decks.



**What You'll Do**



- **Design and refine pitch decks, presentations, creative treatments, capabilities decks, and proposals.** This will be one of your primary responsibilities.

- Build presentations from scratch and elevate existing decks through thoughtful typography, layout, composition, imagery, and visual storytelling.

- Develop and evolve brand identities, including typography, color palettes, visual systems, and brand guidelines.

- Create thoughtful layouts, moodboards, and visual concepts that communicate ideas clearly and beautifully.

- Contribute to packaging concepts, product presentations, and marketing materials.

- Work across multiple brands, each with its own distinct identity, audience, and creative direction.

- Transform rough ideas, references, and existing materials into polished, professional designs.

- Collaborate closely with our team, incorporating feedback while contributing your own creative perspective.



**What We're Looking For**



Above all, we're looking for someone with a great eye for design.



Someone who understands that great design isn't about applying the same aesthetic to every project. It's about finding the right visual language for the idea, brand, or story.



Our ideal candidate has:



- A strong portfolio demonstrating versatility, originality, and thoughtful design.

- **Proven experience creating beautifully designed presentations and pitch decks**, with an excellent understanding of pacing, visual storytelling, and slide composition.

- Excellent understanding of typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy, and layout.

- Experience with branding and identity development, not just creating individual graphics.

- The ability to create custom, intentional designs rather than relying on generic templates.

- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Experience with Google Slides, PowerPoint, and/or Canva, with the ability to create fully editable presentations.

- Strong attention to detail and a willingness to refine work until it feels right.

- Good communication skills, creative curiosity, and the ability to work independently.



Experience with product packaging, editorial design, luxury or lifestyle brands, and entertainment or advertising is a plus.



**The Ideal Fit**



We're looking for a designer who can be both creative and practical.



Some projects will begin with a well-defined direction. Others might start with a few images, a rough concept, or an idea that needs to be explored visually.



You'll need to be comfortable with both.



We appreciate sophisticated, considered design, but don't believe every project should look or feel the same. Some brands call for restraint and simplicity. Others need personality, warmth, energy, or something unexpected.



What matters is the ability to understand the creative intention and develop a visual approach that feels distinctive, cohesive, and appropriate.



We're not looking for someone who simply makes things look nice. We're looking for someone who understands how design gives an idea its identity.



**Position Details**



- Part-time, remote

- Approximately 15–20 hours per week to start

- Flexible schedule, with some availability during Los Angeles business hours

- Ongoing collaboration across several brands and creative projects

- Potential for additional hours and responsibilities as we grow



**To Apply**



Please share your portfolio, **including examples of pitch decks or presentations you've personally designed**, as well as branding and other creative work that demonstrates your range.



We're particularly interested in seeing projects where you've helped establish or interpret a brand's visual identity.



Please also include your preferred design software, hourly rate, and general availability.

title: Senior Executive Assistant & Project Operations Lead – Luxury Residential Design-Build (Remote)
description:
About us

Exhale Designs is a Florida-based residential design and construction firm working on high-end renovations, additions, pools, and full home transformations, with project values reaching into seven figures. Our clients are busy high-income homeowners and real estate investors who hire us so they don’t have to manage the details. We’re growing, and we need a senior right hand who can run the back office of every project so our project manager can focus on the field.



This role is for you if



You think two steps ahead and see the bottleneck before it happens

You own outcomes, not just tasks

You write clearly and professionally enough to represent us to clients, vendors, and town officials

You build systems and processes, not just follow them



What you’ll own



Preconstruction



Keep the latest drawing revisions and contract scope organized and on file

Prepare and track permit applications, Notices of Commencement, and HOA approvals through to approval

Track client selections and get written sign-off before anything is ordered

Flag long-lead items and place or track those orders first

Arrange utility locate requests, dumpsters, and portable toilets before work starts



Subcontractor administration



Prepare sub agreements with a written scope for each trade

Track insurance certificate (COI) expiration dates so coverage never lapses

Collect partial lien releases with every progress payment

Check sub invoices against contract amounts and work completed before payment



Inspections and scheduling



Schedule municipal inspections and track results so nothing gets covered up early

Coordinate sub and vendor schedules with the project manager



Change orders and budget



Write and price change orders, note schedule impact, and get client signatures before work proceeds

Track actual cost against budget weekly in JobTread

Prepare client draws and invoices tied to project milestones



Procurement and deliveries



Create and manage purchase orders for materials, furniture, and finishes

Reconcile deliveries against POs using field reports, and log back orders and returns



Client communication



Draft the weekly client update covering progress, next week’s plan, and decisions needed

Maintain a decision log so every verbal approval is documented



Documentation



Compile daily logs from field notes, including crew on site, work completed, and weather delays

Keep project photos and files organized in JobTread



Closeout



Prepare punch lists and track items to completion

Coordinate final inspections and certificate of occupancy or permit close-out

Assemble the client closeout package with warranties, manuals, and the paint and finish schedule

Collect final photos and client sign-off



Executive support



Manage the owner’s and project manager’s inbox and calendar

Prepare meeting agendas and recaps

Build and improve our templates, checklists, and SOPs as we scale



Requirements



5+ years of executive assistant, project coordinator, or construction administration experience

Direct experience with residential construction paperwork: permits, lien releases, COIs, change orders, and draws

Hands-on experience with JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore, or similar

Strong command of Microsoft 365, Dropbox, and Excel budget tracking

Native-level written and spoken English

Available during US Eastern business hours

References from past executives or clients



Bonus points



Florida permitting experience (Notices of Commencement, municipal portals)

Experience supporting a business owner directly

Background in interior design procurement or luxury home services



Compensation

Competitive pay for top talent: [$12–$20per hour]. Long-term role with room to grow as the company scales.



To apply



Record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and describing the most complex construction project you’ve supported.

In writing, explain how you would make sure no subcontractor gets paid without a current COI and a signed partial lien release.

Start your message with the word “Blueprint.”



Applications missing any of these won’t be reviewed. Finalists will complete a short paid trial task.

title: Senior Tax Accountant with 3+ years Australian Accounting Experience
description:
If you are a Tax Accountant with 3+ years Australian Accounting Experience, we invite you to apply for an exciting remote opportunity with Dolman Bateman, a boutique chartered accounting firm based in Sydney, Australia.



At Dolman Bateman, we serve a wide range of clients, including those in construction, social media content creation, eCommerce, hospitality, finance, manufacturing, and superannuation. With a recent surge in new business ventures, we are expanding our team and seeking skilled professionals in the Philippines to contribute their expertise and further enhance their careers in business accounting and accounting services.



Key Requirements:



Minimum 3 years of proven experience in Australian tax accounting.

Proficiency in bookkeeping, accounting, BAS and IAS preparation, and GST compliance.

Relevant qualifications in Business, Commerce, and/or Accounting.

Strong working knowledge of Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong time management and organizational abilities to meet deadlines.

Ability to work independently, with a strong commitment to responsibility and leadership.

A positive "Can Do" attitude and collaborative team player.

Prepare financial accounts, tax returns, and working papers for various entities, including individuals, companies, trusts, partnerships, and self-managed superannuation funds.

Support the broader team in delivering comprehensive accounting and business services.

7:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Monday to Friday (1-hour lunch break).

title: Remote Landscape Estimator
description:
Remote Landscape Estimator – Commercial & Residential 



Pavecraft Ltd | New Zealand | Remote Working Opportunity 



Join a Growing National Landscaping Business 



Pavecraft Ltd is an established and growing commercial landscaping business delivering high-quality outdoor environments across New Zealand. 



Working across Residential, Commercial and Industrial sectors, we partner with leading construction and civil contractors, developers and government organisations to create exceptional outdoor spaces. 



As our business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Commercial & Residential Landscape Estimator to join our Commercial team in a fully remote capacity. 



This is an opportunity for an experienced estimator who understands both hardscape and softscape construction and has the technical ability to turn landscape drawings into accurate, competitive and commercially sound project estimates. 



You'll play an important role in supporting our national project pipeline, working closely with our Commercial and Operations teams to help secure and deliver quality landscaping projects throughout New Zealand. 



The Opportunity 



The primary focus of this role is to prepare accurate and commercially competitive estimates for a diverse range of commercial and residential landscaping projects. 



You will be responsible for reviewing construction drawings and tender documentation, completing detailed quantity take-offs, preparing schedules of quantities (SOQs), bills of quantities (BOQs), cost build-ups and draft tender estimates. 



Using our established in-house pricing models and estimating tools, you will help ensure projects are priced accurately, efficiently and with a strong understanding of the practical requirements of landscape construction. 



Your Scope of Work 



Hard Landscaping 



Segmental paving including setts, pavers and natural stone. 



Concrete  



Site preparation and associated external works. 



Retaining walls, steps, ramps and associated structures. 



Drainage and stormwater interfaces. 



Landscape structures, street furniture and external works. 



Soft Landscaping 



Soil preparation, garden beds and planting areas. 



Trees, shrubs, ground covers and specimen planting. 



Turfing, lawn installation and hydroseeding. 



Mulching, topsoil and soil conditioning. 



Irrigation systems and associated infrastructure. 



Plant supply, delivery and installation. 



Garden establishment and landscape finishing works. 



Key Responsibilities 



Review construction drawings, specifications and tender documentation to identify and measure project requirements using Groundplan takeoff software 



Complete accurate quantity take-offs and prepare detailed schedules of quantities (SOQs)  



Develop detailed material, labour and plant cost estimates using excel pricing templates 



Populate, maintain and improve company pricing models and estimating tools. 



Obtain, assess and compare supplier and subcontractor pricing. 



Review tender addenda and drawing amendments, ensuring all changes are incorporated into estimates. 



Maintain accurate estimating records and contribute to the development of standardised cost libraries. 



Work collaboratively with Commercial and Operations teams to ensure estimates are practical, accurate and commercially viable. 



Skills & Experience 



We are looking for someone who has a strong background in a commercial landscaping environment. 



Essential Requirements 



High level written and spoken English 



A recognised Quantity Surveying qualification. 



Minimum of 2 years' proven estimating experience within a large commercial landscaping business. 



Demonstrated experience preparing estimates from landscape construction drawings. 



Strong ability to interpret drawings, specifications and tender documentation. 



Proven experience completing detailed quantity take-offs  



Sound understanding of both hardscape and softscape construction methods, materials and installation requirements. 



Knowledge of New Zealand and Australian construction methods and practices. 



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with pricing models. 



Experience using Groundplan quantity take-off software. 



Strong understanding of construction costs, labour requirements, productivity, plant and subcontractor pricing. 



Proficiency across Microsoft platforms. 



Please note: Applicants must be able to provide examples of previous estimating work to demonstrate their technical capability and experience. 



The Person We're Looking For 



Beyond technical estimating ability, we're looking for someone who takes pride in producing accurate work and understands the commercial realities of delivering construction projects. 



You'll demonstrate: 



Strong commercial awareness and exceptional attention to detail. 



Excellent analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills. 



The ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously. 



A proactive and organised approach to your workload. 



Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 



A willingness to continually develop knowledge across both hardscape and softscape disciplines. 



The ability to work independently while remaining connected and collaborative with a wider team. 



A practical understanding of how outdoor construction projects are built, not just how they are priced. 



Ready to Join Us? 



Please submit your CV and a short cover letter along with examples of previous estimating work demonstrating your experience in commercial landscaping. 



Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: UGC Ad Scriptwriter
description:
I’m a UGC creator hiring a scriptwriter to focus on one or two brands. You’ll learn their products, customers, and my voice so your scripts improve over time.



The goal is simple: I show up, read, and film without rewriting scripts.



THE WORK



• 140 distinct scripts weekly, averaging 20 daily.

• Typically 30–60 seconds each.

• Delivered the evening before filming. Weekend batches can be prepared ahead.

• $50 USD per week, including revisions to meet the brief.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



• Strong hooks, storytelling, mini hooks, curiosity loops, and clear CTAs.

• An understanding of customer desires, pain points, and buying objections.

• Resourcefulness in researching products, reviews, competitors, and videos on TikTok, Instagram, and ad libraries.

• Strong English and the ability to recognize and fix awkward writing yourself.

• Conversational scripts that sound like a friend talking, with no filler or corporate language.



AI is encouraged, but you must guide, fact-check, and improve its output. Never invent claims, testimonials, offers, or scarcity.



I’ll provide examples, brand information, filming inventory, and feedback. Keep brand knowledge and previous scripts organized, apply feedback, and bring fresh angles.



DELIVERABLES



Each script needs a concept title, ready-to-read spoken lines, brief filming notes when needed, and links supporting claims or offers. Everything must work with the products I have available.



HOW TO APPLY



Message me with “READY TO FILM,” a brief introduction, and confirmation that the budget and workload work for you.



I’ll send you a product website for a small paid trial. Create a script and explain your process: what you researched, which videos or other sources inspired you, and why you chose your hook and angle. Include source links and explain how you used AI, if applicable.



I want to see your resourcefulness, writing judgment, and whether we work well together.

title: YouTube Video Editor – History, Zoology & Paleontology
description:
ABOUT US



I run a paleontology channel and a zoology channel. I am currently preparing to launch a new history channel and am in need of an editor.



Our videos are narrated, faceless educational videos. I write the scripts and record the voiceovers. We need an editor who can turn that narration into a visual story that keeps viewers watching.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build the full visual track for narrated videos of 15–20+ minutes from the voiceover.

- Research and source visuals that match the script line by line: historical paintings, accurate drawings, photographs, archival footage, B-roll, maps, fossil imagery, scientific illustrations, and more.

- Add motion to keep the videos feeling alive and fluid: simple animations, maps, timelines, labels, and text callouts where they help understanding.

- Deliver a finished 1080p video ready to upload, with up to 3 rounds of revisions.

- Keep a simple source log of where each visual came from.



WORK VOLUME



- About 2–4 videos per month across the channels to start, with room to grow.

- Ongoing contractor relationship.

- Fully remote; worldwide applicants welcome.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU



- Have experience editing faceless, narrated YouTube videos.

- Love finding the right image, not just any image. You'd rather hunt for an 1850s engraving than use generic stock footage.

- Understand pacing and retention: a new visual every few seconds, without long, drawn-out still images.

- Are curious about history, science, or natural history (a big plus).

- Can communicate in English, meet deadlines, and let us know early when you're unavailable.



To let us know you've read this section, put the word "trilobite" at the top of your application, immediately after your name.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with map animations, simple motion graphics, or photo animation.

- Familiarity with sources like Wikimedia Commons, ArtStation, DeviantArt, Pinterest, and documentaries.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Finished scripts and recorded narration for every video.

- Reference videos and a style guide.

- Fast, specific feedback and a steady flow of work for the right person.

- Guidance and support whenever you're stuck. We'll have someone available to offer advice.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your application through the following link:

title: Remote Cold Caller – Appointment Setter, Path to Commission-Based Closer (Web Solutions Company)
description:
Job overview:



• Company: A web solutions company

• Location: 100% remote (Philippines-based)

• Type: Full-time, long-term

• Working hours: 9 AM to 5 PM US time (this is a night shift in Philippine time)

• Start date: We will contact applicants for onboarding starting immediately



About the role:



We are a web solutions company growing our client base through outbound calling.

You will cold call businesses and offer them a free, in-depth analysis of their website and their Google and AI search rankings. Your main goal on every call is to get the business to accept the free analysis. Your second goal is to book a call between the prospect and our founder.

You'll work from a simple, proven script. You won't need to sell services or explain technical details on the call. You just need to get the yes and collect the right details.

Over time, strong performers will have the opportunity to move into a commission-based sales role as a closer. This is a genuine growth opportunity for people who deliver results.



Key responsibilities:



• Make outbound cold calls to businesses from the lists we provide.

• Offer our free website and Google and AI search rankings analysis using our call script.

• Collect the prospect's details accurately: names, website,
, phone number, role, and their main website goal or pain point.

• Submit each accepted analysis through our booking form and website tool.

• Book calls with our founder for interested prospects, and for businesses that don't have a website yet.

• Keep accurate records of every call.

• Meet weekly targets for calls made, conversations, analyses accepted and calls booked.



Requirements:



• Near-perfect spoken English (non-negotiable).

• Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, sales or customer service is a big plus.

• Confident on the phone and comfortable hearing "no."

• Self-motivated, persistent, organized and comfortable working remotely.

• Reliable computer/laptop, good headset and stable high-speed internet.

• Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US time (a night shift in Philippine time). Exact hours may shift slightly depending on which US time zone we're calling.

• Fast learner and coachable.



Trial period and pay:



Every new team member starts on a paid trial period. Trial period will be paid at $4 per analysis accepted. The trial ends as soon as you get your first free analysis accepted by a prospect.

From that point on, you are paid $4 USD per hour, full-time.



What we offer:



• $4 USD per hour once you complete the trial period.

• Full-time, long-term, stable work with a growing company.

• A clear, simple call script. No technical selling required.

• Training on our offer, script, tools and process.

• All necessary tools and lead lists provided.

• A path to a commission-based closer role over time for top performers, with very high earning potential.



How to apply:



Only serious applicants who follow instructions will be considered.

1. Send your updated resume/CV.

2. In the first line of your message, write exactly: "I have near-perfect English and am available for voice interviews."

3. Record a short voice message (30–60 seconds, using 
 or a similar tool). Introduce yourself, explain why you're interested in a cold calling role, and show us your English speaking ability. Attach or link the audio file.



We will immediately review applications and reach out to selected candidates for onboarding. Thank you in advance to everyone who applies!
