title: Operations & Systems Virtual Assistant (VA)
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and tech-savvy Operations & Systems Virtual Assistant to support the owner in managing day-to-day operations, business systems, administrative processes, and team coordination across multiple businesses.



Our businesses operate in several industries, including after-school programs, real estate, and other entrepreneurial ventures.



This is not a basic data-entry or task-based VA position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of responsibilities, manage projects and workflows, coordinate people, identify operational gaps, and ensure things get done without constant direction.



The ideal candidate is an organized problem-solver who understands business operations, is comfortable managing multiple priorities, and has hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).



Key Responsibilities



1. Business Operations & Administrative Management



Manage and track daily operations, priorities, deadlines, and outstanding tasks across multiple businesses.

Maintain organized systems for documents, records, reports, and business information.

Coordinate with employees, contractors, vendors, clients, and business partners.

Make phone calls, send
s, communicate updates, and follow up on outstanding items.

Monitor ongoing projects and ensure responsibilities are completed on schedule.

Identify operational issues, bring them to the owner's attention, and proactively recommend solutions.

Prepare daily or weekly operational updates and reports.

Help establish and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs).

2. GoHighLevel (GHL) & Systems Management



Assist with GoHighLevel account setup, configuration, and ongoing management.

Build, manage, and troubleshoot workflows, automations, pipelines, and triggers.

Set up and maintain CRM systems, contact databases, forms, calendars, and communication sequences.

Assist with lead management, follow-up systems, and customer communication automation.

Monitor automation performance and identify opportunities to improve business processes.

Help organize and standardize systems across multiple business ventures.

Maintain accurate documentation of workflows and system processes.

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience is mandatory. Applicants must be able to demonstrate actual experience building and managing GHL systems.



3. Program & Team Coordination



Assist with the daily operations of after-school programs.

Coordinate staff schedules, attendance, and administrative requirements.

Track program-related tasks, deadlines, and outstanding responsibilities.

Communicate with staff and ensure operational procedures are followed.

Help maintain organized records and consistent administrative processes.

4. Real Estate & Business Support



Assist with real estate administrative tasks and document organization.

Track important dates, appointments, follow-ups, and transaction-related paperwork.

Provide general operational support for new projects, business initiatives, and other ventures.

Mandatory Qualifications & Requirements



GoHighLevel experience is mandatory. Must have hands-on experience setting up accounts, workflows, automations, pipelines, and CRM systems.

Previous experience in business operations, operations management, project coordination, or executive assistance is strongly preferred.

Experience supporting multiple businesses or managing several projects simultaneously is a plus.

Excellent organizational, time-management, and follow-through skills.

Strong written and spoken English with clear, professional communication. Spanish is a plus.

Comfortable making phone calls, communicating with different stakeholders, and following up professionally.

Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software and business systems.

Able to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and solve problems without constant supervision.

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.

A noise-canceling headset is preferred. There must be absolutely no distracting background noise during calls.

Must maintain a professional appearance and be camera-ready during working hours.

This position must be your primary and only work commitment. No job stacking or competing work obligations.

Christian faith is a plus. Applicants must respect and align with the owner's and company's values of integrity, accountability, honesty, professionalism, and excellence.



Work Expectations & Accountability



We are looking for someone who takes ownership rather than simply waiting for instructions.



The successful candidate must:



Be proactive and anticipate what needs to be done.

Follow through on assignments without repeated reminders.

Communicate clearly and consistently.

Keep systems, records, and tasks organized.

Bring problems forward along with potential solutions.

Protect confidential business information.

Maintain a high level of professionalism and accountability.

There is zero tolerance for dishonesty, unprofessional conduct, repeated missed deadlines, poor communication, or failure to take responsibility.



Compensation & Advancement



Months 1–6: Probationary Period



$4 per hour.

Part-time position.

Performance will be evaluated based on reliability, initiative, communication, accuracy, organization, and ability to manage responsibilities independently.

After 6 Months: Potential Advancement



Successful candidates may qualify for a full-time position at $6 per hour.

$1,500 completion bonus, subject to successful completion of the probationary period and performance evaluation.

Advancement is based on demonstrated performance, dependability, and the ability to become a trusted operations partner.



How to Apply



To be considered, applicants must submit:



Resume: Include relevant experience in business operations, executive assistance, project coordination, CRM management, and GoHighLevel.

Video Introduction (1–3 minutes): Introduce yourself and explain your professional background, experience managing business operations, specific GoHighLevel skills, and why you would be a good fit for this position.

Letters of Recommendation: Optional but encouraged.

Applications submitted without both a resume and video introduction will not be considered.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for more than an assistant. We want someone who can become a dependable operations partner across multiple businesses.



Someone who is organized, resourceful, detail-oriented, technologically capable, and comfortable taking ownership.



If you are the type of person who sees what needs to be done, creates a system to get it done, follows through, and keeps business operations moving forward, we encourage you to apply.

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "QUALITY CHECK" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Heir Outreach Specialist
description:
We are hiring the person everyone tells things to.



JABO REI is a US real estate firm. We buy houses families inherited and never settled. The paperwork tells us what happened, never why a family left its largest asset untouched for ten years. Your job: be the first voice that family hears — and come back with the why.



Most callers stop at the first answer. Ours don't.



An heir says: "We just haven't gotten around to it." That's Level 1 — the reason given. Level 2 is the cause: what made it hard to get around to? "My brother won't return my calls." Level 3 is the root: why won't he? He cared for their mother in that house. He believes it's his.



Reaching Level 3 can't be scripted. It happens because the heir said one sentence that wasn't the whole story — and you noticed, and your next question walked through the door it opened. If you already listen this way, you know what we're describing. If you don't, no training fixes it. That's why we test for it before we hire.



The work



- First calls to heirs from fully researched files — family tree, debts, documents — during US hours (overnight PH).

- You talk less than a third of the time. No selling, no pitch, no commission — a separate team handles offers, by design.

- Every call ends with something real: a next step at a specific time, or a family that trusts you'll call back.

- Your notes retell the whole story, complications included.

- Calls are recorded and graded on depth and listening, never dial volume.

- Hours start at 4/day, growing as your deals close: 5 after your first, 6 after your second.



Don't apply if a script is your safety net, silence makes you fill it, commission is your fuel, or a painful story sends you reaching for comfortable phrases.



Background: outbound calling experience is required — you must already be at home on live calls with strangers. Real estate and sales experience are not: sales habits usually have to be unlearned here. Our best people come from escalations, retention, intake, care coordination — anywhere the real job was hearing people in hard moments.



Pay: $5/hr starting, flexible based on skill — the assessment d
 where you land. Remote.



How hiring works (same for everyone):



1. Answer the application question below.

2. A personal packet: résumé plus a free DISC assessment.

3. Two timed tests — aptitude, and a Curiosity Test of real conversation fragments: you choose the next question. We hire from these results more than from résumés.

4. A short video, then an interview and a live roleplay call.



Application question (required): Tell us about a conversation where you heard the sentence everyone else missed — the one that changed what the conversation was really about. How far did you follow it, and was there anything you deliberately chose not to say? Specifics, please — vague answers are how we screen out.



— JABO REI

Your Build AI is an Australian technology company specialising in AI-powered software development, intelligent automation and business transformation.



We work with businesses, including large organisations and enterprise-level clients, to design, develop and implement sophisticated AI solutions that improve operations, eliminate inefficiencies and create genuine commercial advantages.



Our work goes beyond basic automation and chatbot development. We build complex, integrated technology solutions, including AI agents, custom software, intelligent workflows, API integrations, business management systems and bespoke AI-powered platforms.



We’re growing and looking for an exceptional developer to become a key part of the business and help lead the technical development and delivery of our projects.



The Opportunity



We’re looking for an absolute weapon in software development and AI engineering.



This isn’t an entry-level position, and we’re not looking for someone who has simply jumped on the AI bandwagon over the last couple of years.



We want someone who was passionate about software engineering long before the current AI boom. Someone with a strong foundation in traditional software development who has since evolved their skill set to understand and leverage the latest advancements in artificial intelligence.



You’ll be responsible for both building solutions yourself and overseeing the technical direction of projects.



You’ll work closely with business leadership, clients and other stakeholders to architect, develop and deliver sophisticated technology solutions.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of the technical function of a growing company, work on substantial projects and play a major role in shaping the future of the business.



What We’re Looking For



1. Strong Software Engineering Foundations



A substantial background in software development, PREdating the recent AI boom.

Deep understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms and software architecture.

Strong experience with backend and frontend development.

Ability to independently design, develop, debug and maintain complex applications.

Understanding of databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security and scalable system design.

Ability to write clean, efficient, maintainable and production-ready code.



2. Advanced AI & Automation Experience



Extensive practical experience developing and implementing AI-powered applications.

Experience working with LLMs, including OpenAI, Anthropic and other leading AI models.

Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, RAG systems, vector databases and retrieval pipelines.

Experience with AI orchestration frameworks and automation platforms.

Ability to integrate AI into existing business systems and software environments.

Understanding of model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, reliability and production deployment.



3. Full-Stack Development & Integrations



Strong experience building full-stack applications.

Extensive experience working with APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations.

Experience with modern frameworks and programming languages.

Familiarity with cloud environments, deployment pipelines, CI/CD and infrastructure.

Ability to build custom platforms, dashboards, portals and complex business applications.

Experience connecting multiple software systems into cohesive, intelligent ecosystems.



4. Technical Leadership & Project Ownership



Ability to independently architect and lead complex development projects.

Confident making technical decisions and recommending the right solutions.

Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliverables.

Experience managing development timelines, priorities and project delivery.

Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Willingness to take complete ownership of projects from initial concept through to deployment and ongoing optimisation.



A Very Important Requirement: Genuine Development Expertise



We want to make something very clear.



We embrace AI and expect our developers to use the latest tools to improve productivity. However, we are not looking for someone who relies entirely on AI coding assistants to produce work they don’t fundamentally understand.



You must be able to write, understand, review, debug and optimise code independently.



You should understand exactly what your code is doing, why it works, how the underlying systems interact and how to resolve problems when things go wrong.



AI should make you a better developer, not substitute for your development knowledge.



We want someone who can build sophisticated systems from the ground up, not someone who can only prompt their way through a project.



Portfolio & Previous Work – Mandatory



This is a non-negotiable requirement.



Applicants must have their own professional website or portfolio showcasing their development experience, previous projects and technical capabilities.



We specifically want to see developers who have taken the initiative to build their own professional online presence.



Your portfolio should demonstrate:



Previous software development projects.

AI applications or automation systems you’ve built.

Examples of complex integrations or platforms you’ve developed.

Your technical capabilities and development experience.

Your specific role and contribution to the projects showcased.



We want to see real work, not just a list of technologies on a CV.



Applicants without a personal professional website or portfolio showcasing their work will not be considered.



Technologies & Experience



Experience with some or most of the following is highly desirable:



Python, JavaScript and TypeScript.

React, Next.js and Node.js.

FastAPI, Django or similar backend frameworks.

PostgreSQL, Supabase and other database technologies.

OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.

LangChain, LangGraph and similar AI frameworks.

RAG architecture and vector databases.

REST APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations.

AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent cloud infrastructure.

Docker, Git, CI/CD and deployment infrastructure.

AI agents, workflow orchestration and intelligent automation.



We value actual engineering capability over familiarity with a particular technology stack.



What We Offer



We’re looking for someone who wants more than just another development job.



The successful applicant will receive:



Full-time employment.

Competitive remuneration based on experience and capability.

Performance-based bonuses and additional incentives.

Additional perks and benefits.

Opportunity to work on significant projects for large businesses and enterprise clients.

Significant autonomy and ownership over technical delivery.

Direct involvement in technical strategy and business growth.

Opportunity to build and lead the technical function as the company scales.

A position where exceptional performance and contribution are genuinely rewarded.



For the right person, there is significant long-term opportunity.



Who Should Apply?



You should be someone who:



Has spent years developing software and understands the fundamentals inside out.

Has successfully built and deployed multiple real-world applications.

Is genuinely passionate about technology and engineering.

Has kept up with the latest advancements in AI and knows how to implement them properly.

Can work independently without needing constant supervision.

Is comfortable taking responsibility for complex technical projects.

Takes pride in the quality, performance and reliability of their work.

Wants to be part of something ambitious and help build a serious technology company.



We’re not looking for someone who simply wants to complete tickets and collect a salary. We want someone who takes ownership, thinks commercially and is motivated by building exceptional technology.





Please only apply if you have your own website & genuinely meet the experience and technical requirements outlined above.



Your Build AI

title: Youtube Long Form Editor
description:
Job Title: Experienced YouTube Editor – Engaging, Funny & Aesthetic Edits (Long-Term)



1 VIDEO A WEEK



About Me

I’m Henry, a YouTube creator (KINGHENRY) and founder of a clothing brand based in Sydney, Australia. My channel covers self-improvement, glow-ups, running, and behind-the-scenes life building my business. My main series is a weekly glow-up vlog, plus lifestyle vlogs and short-form content.



My content is deadpan, self-deprecating, and full of anime, gaming, and internet-culture references. I need an editor who gets that humour and can make it hit harder on screen.



The Role

I’m looking for an experienced YouTube editor to join long-term and take ownership of my long-form videos. This is an ongoing role, not a one-off gig. The right person will grow with the channel.



The Editing Style I Want



Engaging, retention-focused editing: tight cuts, no dead air, strong hooks, and pacing that keeps viewers watching

Funny editing: comedic timing, meme inserts, zooms, sound effects, captions, and reaction moments that land the joke

Clean, punchy cutting: jump cuts and rhythm that make talking segments feel fast and alive

Aesthetic edits: cinematic B-roll sequences, montages, music-driven cuts, and colour grading that looks premium



Responsibilities



Edit weekly long-form YouTube videos (vlogs, glow-up series, lifestyle content)

Colour grade footage shot on a DJI Osmo Pocket 3 in D-Log M (using FilmConvert Nitrate, which I provide)

Add music, sound design, captions, and graphics

Turn around revisions based on feedback in 
 (up to 3 review rounds)

Deliver final files through Google Drive

Hit agreed deadlines consistently



Requirements



At least a year of editing youtube videos experience

A portfolio of YouTube videos you’ve edited (links required)

Strong comedic timing and an understanding of internet and meme culture

Experience colour grading log footage

Proficient in either Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

Good English communication and reliable internet

Available during Australian business hours (AEST) for communication



Bonus Points



Experience with vlog or lifestyle content

Short-form editing (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

Motion graphics or After Effects skills

You watch anime or play games and get the references



Pay & Hours



750 USD A MONTH

Long-term role, with pay increases based on performance



Hiring Process



Apply with your portfolio

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid test edit using my real footage

Short call with me

Start working



How to Apply

Send:



Links to 2–3 YouTube videos you edited that best show funny, engaging, or aesthetic editing

Your editing software and your typical turnaround time for a 10–15 minute video

Your monthly rate

Start your application with the words “LOCKED IN” so I know you read the full post



Applications without portfolio links won’t be considered.

title: AI Automation Specialist (Claude Code + Python) - Part-Time
description:
Remote · Part-Time · 20 hours per week, you set your own hours

Mario Moosbauer · Growald Agency · Munich, Germany



ABOUT US



I'm Mario Moosbauer. I run Growald Agency, an AI agency specialising in e-commerce and Amazon, and Natureich, our own Amazon brand for wooden math toys. We build AI automations for our clients and for our own companies: reports, listings, inventory planning,
 handling, sales follow-up.



Most of this runs on Claude Code and Python. I need someone who can build these automations with me and later on their own.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



We have experts in our team and at our clients. A Google Ads manager, an Amazon account manager, a bookkeeper, a customer service lead. They know how their work is done, but it lives in their heads.



Your job:



1. Sit down with the expert (video call) and ask until you understand exactly how they work, including the exceptions.

2. Write it down as a clear process.

3. Build the automation with Claude Code and Python: scripts, API connections, scheduled runs.

4. Test it on real data, hand it over with short documentation and make sure it keeps running without you.



Your first projects will be automations for our agency clients.



MEASURABLE OUTCOMES



1. At least 2 working automations per month that run on a schedule without manual starts.

2. Every automation states the hours it saves per month, measured before and after.

3. Automations you own run without failure in at least 95% of scheduled runs. When one breaks, you know before the client does.

4. Every automation has a short README that someone else can follow.



MUST-HAVES



- You write Python yourself: scripts, APIs, data processing.

- You already build with AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, the OpenAI or Anthropic API, or agent frameworks.

- You can show at least one automation you built that is running today (GitHub link, demo video or client project).

- Good written and spoken English. You will interview experts and explain results.

- You solve problems on your own. I give you the goal, you find the way.



Nice to have: n8n or Make experience, Shopify or Amazon Seller Central, Google Workspace APIs, Git, basic German.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- you only write ChatGPT prompts and have never shipped code

- you need step-by-step instructions for every task

- you have certificates and courses but nothing you built yourself

- you already work several full-time jobs



POSITION DETAILS



Schedule: 20 hrs/week, flexible, you choose when you work

Location: 100% remote

Contract: Freelance

Start: As soon as possible

Growth: More hours as results come in



HOW TO APPLY



Send me a message here on OnlineJobs with your CV. In your message, describe ONE automation you built that is running today: what it replaced, which tools and code you used, and how much time or money it saves. A link to the code or a short demo video helps a lot.



Applications without a real example will not be considered.



Mario Moosbauer

Growald Agency ·

title: Administrative & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
About Plentyy Cars



Plentyy Cars is a growing vehicle rental company committed to providing customers with reliable transportation, convenient rental options, and exceptional service. We serve customers through private vehicle rentals and online rental platforms, with a focus on creating a seamless experience from initial inquiry through vehicle return.

As we continue expanding our fleet and operations, we're building a dependable team of individuals who take ownership of their work, communicate effectively, and contribute to the success of the business.



Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Administrative & Operations Virtual Assistant to support the daily administrative functions of our vehicle rental business. This position plays an important role in maintaining vehicle records, tracking expenses, monitoring administrative deadlines, organizing company documents, and supporting operational reporting.

The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple recurring responsibilities, working with spreadsheets, learning new technology, and ensuring that important business information remains accurate and accessible.



Key Responsibilities



Fleet Administration & Vehicle Records

- Maintain accurate vehicle information and administrative records.

- Monitor vehicle registration dates and upcoming renewals.

- Track toll accounts, FasTrak balances, parking tickets, and outstanding notices.

- Maintain records of vehicle tracking devices and related equipment.

- Monitor maintenance schedules, including oil changes, tire inspections, and other service requirements.

- Coordinate maintenance reminders and follow-ups with the local operations team.

- Track vehicle downtime, service appointments, and outstanding maintenance issues.

- Identify administrative discrepancies and escalate concerns to management.



Financial Recordkeeping & Expense Administration

- Organize vehicle-related receipts and expense documentation.

- Maintain business expense records using designated systems.

- Ensure expenses are categorized and associated with the appropriate vehicle when applicable.

- Identify missing receipts, duplicate entries, and incomplete financial records.

- Assist with tracking vehicle-level revenue, operating expenses, and rental activity.

- Prepare monthly vehicle performance and profitability summaries for management review.

- Maintain organized and accessible financial documentation.



Business Administration

- Organize and maintain company files, documents, and operational records.

- Assist with employee scheduling and administrative coordination.

- Track employee onboarding requirements and training completion.

- Maintain internal calendars and recurring operational deadlines.

- Coordinate with approved vendors, software providers, and service partners.

- Support routine administrative communications and follow-ups.

- Assist with payroll preparation by organizing approved employee information and records.



SOP & Training Documentation

- Maintain the company's standard operating procedures and training library.

- Organize training manuals, instructional videos, and employee resources.

- Identify outdated instructions, missing information, or broken document links.

- Assist with updating procedures and maintaining document version control.

- Support the organization of employee onboarding and training materials.



Marketing & General Operations Support

- Assist with organizing approved marketing materials and vehicle photographs.

- Maintain promotional and social media content calendars.

- Support the scheduling of approved social media posts.

- Track marketing-related administrative tasks.

- Provide backup support for routine customer service responsibilities when trained and authorized.



Reporting & Communication

- Complete assigned daily and weekly administrative checklists.

- Prepare operational summaries and administrative status reports.

- Track outstanding tasks, upcoming deadlines, and unresolved issues.

- Communicate updates to the Operations Manager and relevant team members.

- Maintain accurate records of completed work and pending follow-ups.



Required Qualifications

- Previous experience in administrative support, virtual assistance, or business operations.

- Strong proficiency with Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Drive, and
 platforms.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Experience maintaining spreadsheets, trackers, and digital records.

- Ability to manage multiple deadlines and recurring tasks.

- Strong written communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and prioritize responsibilities.

- Comfortable learning new software and digital tools.

- Reliable internet connection and appropriate remote workspace.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in transportation, fleet management, automotive services, or rental businesses.

- Familiarity with bookkeeping support or expense tracking.

- Experience maintaining SOPs and employee training documentation.

- Experience with project management or task management software.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms and workflow automation tools.

- Previous experience supporting small-business operations.



What We're Looking For

- We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure and organization to a growing business.

- The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of identifying missing information or potential problems before they become larger issues.

- You should be comfortable working with multiple systems, learning new processes, and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.



Performance Expectations

Success will be evaluated through record accuracy, timely completion of administrative responsibilities, maintenance of required documentation, reporting consistency, and effective communication of outstanding issues.

Software Ecosystem Mastery:

title: Vehicle Electrical Fitout Designer (12/24V)
description:
About RXI

RXI Group designs and builds service bodies and vehicle fitouts for fleet, utility and mining customers across Australia. Every build includes a custom electrical fitout: lighting, beacons, compressors, inverters, auxiliary batteries, controllers and CAN-based modules. We are building an in-house electrical design team and need someone who understands how these systems actually work on a vehicle.

The role

You will take a build scope and a list of components, and work out the full electrical fitout: what each device needs, where its power comes from, how it is switched, fused and earthed, and how it all ties back into the vehicle. You will then produce the schematic and wiring documentation the workshop builds from.

Key responsibilities

• Review build scopes and component datasheets, and work out the wiring requirements for each device

• Design 12/24V circuits: power source (main or auxiliary battery), isolators, fuses and circuit breakers, switches, relays and earths

• Develop electrical schematics and wiring diagrams for each build

• Select wire sizes, fuse ratings, connectors and terminals

• Prepare electrical BOMs

• Work with the workshop and installers to resolve fitout and installation issues

• Learn and use Onshape to route harnesses in 3D (full training provided)

Must have

• Hands-on or design experience with vehicle electrical fitouts, auto electrical, 4WD/fleet accessory installs, or automotive harness and EDS work

• Strong understanding of 12/24V vehicle systems, including dual battery setups, DC-DC chargers, isolators, relays, fusing and earthing

• Ability to look at a component and its datasheet and work out how to wire it, without being given a diagram

• Ability to draw clear schematics in AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, Zuken E3 or similar

• Good written English and able to work independently with an Australian team

Nice to have

• Electrical, electronics or automotive qualification

• Any 3D CAD experience





How to apply

Send your CV and a short note describing a vehicle electrical fitout or circuit you have designed or installed. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short practical test before interview.

________________________________________



Screening steps

1. Practical test first: candidate is given 2-3 fitout components (e.g. beacon, work light, compressor) and draws how to wire them (power source, fuse, switch, relay, earth), selects wire size and fuse rating, and explains why

title: Outbound Appointment Setter: Roofing Owners, Free Audit Offer (Bring Your Own Dialer and A2P Setup)
description:
ABOUT CURAVIA STUDIO:

Curavia Studio is a young marketing studio in Bloomington, Indiana, serving roofing companies in the Indianapolis market. We build and run lead follow-up and appointment booking systems for roofers: ads on the client's own account, every lead answered in under five minutes, booking on the client's calendar, review requests, and a weekly report. We are honest about our stage: we are signing our first founding roofing partners now, and this hire is part of how we reach them. You would be our first acquisition setter, working directly with the founder's team.



THE JOB:

You sell conversations, not services. Your work is reaching roofing company owners and offering them two free things: a personalized audit of how their company captures and follows up leads (theirs to keep either way), and a short recorded demo of our system working on a real test lead. When an owner says yes, you book a free 15 to 30 minute growth call on our calendar. That is the win. You never pitch our price and you never close a sale; the decision happens later, in writing, without you on the line.



- Outbound calls to roofing owners from lists we provide (Indianapolis area first), working from a short written audit we prepare for each company

- Paced participation in roofing owner
 groups from our real business presence: helpful posts, real answers, conversations that end at the free audit offer

- DM follow-up with owners who engaged, inside our follow-up rules (one polite follow-up, then silence)

- Book calls on our calendar through our booking link and log every touch in our CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day

- Route any price, terms, or objection question to our team the same day instead of improvising an answer



Each week you receive a fresh call list from us: company names, owner names, phone numbers, and a short audit brief for each company. You never buy lists, and you never build or bring your own lists.



A HARD REQUIREMENT OF THIS SEAT: YOUR OWN CALLING SETUP.

You call on your own dialer and your own A2P-registered numbers, with your own compliance registration in good standing. Our own phone registration is still in process, which is exactly why this seat is structured this way. If you do not already have a working dialer and registered numbers you control, this posting is not for you. In your application, describe your setup in your own words (see the application questions). We will ask about it again in the interview.



HOURS:

- Part time, about 20 hours per week, scheduled in US Eastern Time calling windows (our owners are in Indiana, and owners answer before crews roll and after jobs wrap)

- Reliability matters more than volume: the windows you commit to are the windows you work

- A normal shift is 40 to 60 dials across your scheduled window, with every call logged the same day



REQUIREMENTS:

- Filipino VA working from home (this posting is for direct hire via OnlineJobs.ph)

- Excellent spoken English: roofing owners, often on a job site with noise around them, must understand you easily on the first pass. Written English must be clean enough for DMs an owner would forward to a partner

- A working dialer and A2P-registered numbers that you own or control, in good standing, described concretely in your application

- Prior outbound appointment-setting experience; roofing, home-services, or other contractor outbound experience is a strong plus

- Quiet workspace, good USB headset, reliable high-speed internet, and a backup connection plan you can describe

- Comfortable in a CRM: every touch logged the same day. GoHighLevel experience is a plus, any CRM discipline helps

- Comfortable being recorded and reviewed: our team listens to call recordings for coaching and quality

- Available to start within one week of an offer, and looking for a long-term seat



PAY (FIXED BASE SALARY PLUS PERFORMANCE BONUSES, STATED EXACTLY):

- Fixed base salary: $260 per month for part-time work at about 20 hours per week (about $60 per week). Paid weekly, in arrears, against a simple activity log (hours worked and calls made, from your dialer). The base salary is yours for the hours you work, whether or not a show happens that week. The first week is a paid trial week at this same base rate.

- How the base is verified (read this carefully): base pay is paid only against evidence, never against a report of effort. Every shift must produce (1) your dialer's call log for that shift (numbers dialed, call durations, outcomes), (2) call recordings, which our team reviews for quality, and (3) a CRM entry for every touch, logged the same day. Time with no dialer log, no recordings, or no CRM entries is not paid, because we cannot verify it happened. A normal shift is sustained outbound dialing across your scheduled window (we compare your volume with what you told us you have sustained in past roles, in your application). If the logs show the work, the base is paid in full and on time, every week.

- Plus $25 for every Qualified Show, on top of the base salary. A Qualified Show means: the owner or a decision maker of a roofing company in our target market attends the Free Growth Call you booked (a real attendance of at least 15 minutes), the booking was made by you and logged in our CRM before the call, and the company was not already in conversation with Curavia before your first touch. A booking alone is not a show. A no-show is not a show.

- Plus 5% of cash collected on clients whose first Qualified Show you booked: 5% of the Curavia fees that client actually pays and that clear (the buildout start and the monthly partnership payments). Client ad spend never counts; it is never ours. Paid after the client's payment clears, on the weekly pay cycle, 7 days after the underlying cash clears.

- Worked example, so there is no mystery: in a month where you book a show, the owner becomes a client, and Curavia collects a $300 buildout start plus the first $1,500 monthly payment, $1,800 total, you receive your $260 base salary plus the $25 show bonus plus $90 (5% of $1,800): $375 for that month.

- If a client payment you were paid a bonus on is later refunded or reversed, the matching bonus or percentage is reversed in the same proportion.



HOW TO APPLY: Answer every application question in this posting, in your own words. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for a voice recording and a live interview with a role-play. Copy-paste applications are deleted unread.



APPLICATION SCREENING QUESTIONS:

1. Your calling setup, in your own words. Name your dialer. Where do your numbers come from? How does your A2P registration work, and how do you handle opt-outs, do-not-call requests, and call recording consent? Be concrete: we are hiring this seat partly because the setup is yours, and we need to understand exactly what we are relying on.

2. How many outbound dials have you sustained per day in past roles, and in what industries? What did a normal shift look like?

3. Have you done outbound calling for roofing, home-services, or other contractor companies? Describe the offer you were setting appointments for.

4. Record a 30 to 60 second voice note introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this role, and attach or link it with your application.

5. Written pitch exercise. Write the first 3 sentences of a call to a roofing owner whose company you have never spoken to. You are offering a free audit of how his company captures and follows up leads. Write exactly what you would say, word for word. (We read this more closely than anything else in your application.)

6. An owner says: "Not interested. Do not call me again." Walk us through exactly what you do in the next 60 seconds, and exactly what you log in the CRM afterward.

7. Part of this seat is paced participation in roofing owner
 groups from our real business account: helpful posts, genuine answers, no spam, no extra profiles. Have you done community or group-based outreach before? Describe how you worked and what pace you kept.

8. Our owners are in Indiana (US Eastern Time). This seat is about 20 hours per week in Eastern calling windows. Which windows can you reliably cover every week, in Philippine time?

9. Describe your internet setup (provider, typical speed), your backup plan when it fails, your workspace, and your headset.

10. This seat pays a fixed base salary of $260 per month (part time, about 20 hours per week) plus a bonus per qualified show and a percentage of collected client fees. Have you worked a base-plus-bonus pay structure before? When could you start, and are you looking for long-term work?

 (the largest marketplace in the Netherlands and Belgium) and Amazon Germany. Our products are made in China, shipped by container to the Netherlands and stored at a fulfillment warehouse. In 2027 we plan to ship around 100 containers (about 2 per week) and process roughly 80,000 orders. We are a small, ambitious team of three founders and we work closely with AI tools that connect to our sales, stock and logistics data.



The role

We have a lot of data: daily stock per SKU, orders and profit per product, marketplace visits and conversion, search volume, shipments and invoices. Right now it sits in separate exports and spreadsheets. We are looking for someone who turns this data into a simple, reliable system that tells us what to order, when, and how much, and who then runs our supply chain with it every day.



You don't need to be a software developer. We are looking for someone who builds smart tools with AI (ChatGPT, Claude), no-code tools, Google Sheets, Airtable, Looker Studio or similar, and who understands supply chain well enough to know what the numbers mean. You report directly to the founders. Final purchasing decisions are approved by the founders, but you prepare them.



What you will build (first 1-3 months)

- One central stock and sales overview per product, combining our warehouse software (ChannelDock), profit tool (Fivex), 
 and Amazon data

- A demand forecast per SKU that corrects for past stock-outs (real demand, not only what we sold) and for seasonality

- A reorder and container planning tool: what to order, when, taking production and shipping lead times into account

- Simple dashboards and automatic alerts (low stock, delays, cost increases) that the founders can understand at a glance

- Clean data rules: for example, products that have two EAN codes, stock that looks wrong, or missing links in our systems



What you will do every day

- Plan stock per SKU and prepare purchase proposals using the system you built

- Plan containers with our supplier in China and our freight forwarder, and track shipments and lead times

- Make sure goods are received correctly at our warehouse in the Netherlands

- Check supplier and logistics invoices against agreed prices and flag mistakes

- Spot problems early (stock-outs, delays, cost increases) and propose solutions

- Request quotes from alternative suppliers, freight forwarders and warehouses, and keep an overview of all cost prices

- Keep improving and automating: if a task is done twice, find a way to automate it



What we are looking for

- 3+ years of experience in supply chain, inventory planning, purchasing or data analysis, ideally for an e-commerce or Amazon business

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, forecasting), and you love working with data

- Hands-on experience building tools, dashboards or automations with AI and/or no-code tools (show us an example!)

- Working with APIs, CSV exports, Zapier/Make or basic SQL/Python is a big plus, but not required

- Precise and structured: you notice when numbers don't add up and you find out why

- Able to explain complex data in simple words to non-technical founders

- Very good written English

- Experience with importing from China, containers (FCL) or a 3PL warehouse is a plus

- Stable internet connection and a quiet place to work

- Able to overlap at least 4 hours with Central European Time (CET) working hours



What we offer

- Long-term, full-time remote position

- Direct contact with the founders and a lot of ownership

- Freedom to choose and build your own tools, with access to modern AI tools

- Room to grow as the company scales towards millions in revenue

- Paid time off for Philippine holidays



How to apply

Start your application with the word "SKYCASES" so we know you read this post. Tell us briefly about your supply chain or data experience, and share one example of a tool, dashboard or automation you built yourself (a screenshot or short description is enough). Applications without this will not be considered.

title: VSL + AI Video Specialist for a New E-commerce Brand
description:
I’m the founder of a new e-commerce brand, and I’m building my dream team from the ground up, starting with YOU.



This is a rare opportunity to be the FIRST editor on board. You won’t be just another freelancer in a crowd. You’ll be employee #1 on the creative side. As the brand scales, the people who joined early get the first shot at bigger roles, more responsibility and leadership positions.



When I grow, you grow. That’s the deal.



Your responsibilities



- Primary focus: long-form VSLs (2+ minutes). Structure hook → problem → agitation → solution → proof → offer, with pacing that holds attention for minutes, not just a 15-second hook.

- Create realistic AI video. Generate lifelike b-roll, scenes and characters that blend seamlessly with real footage, with no uncanny faces, warped hands or glitchy motion.

- Keep AI content consistent. The same character, product and lighting across multiple clips and scenes.

- Produce AI voiceovers and lip-sync that sound natural and on-brand.

- Edit with clean cuts, captions, b-roll and sound design.

- Know where to find quality stock footage and music, and when AI is the better option.

- Keep project files organised (note: start your application with the word PIXEL).

- Turn edits around quickly and handle revisions without ego.



Who I’m looking for:

Someone hungry and creative who wants to actually matter. Mindset over résumé: fast, organised, detail-obsessed, takes ownership, and handles feedback without taking it personally.



- Solid written and spoken English

- Proven experience editing direct response VSLs that convert, not just short-form social cuts

- Hands-on experience with current AI video tools, such as Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Midjourney and Freepik. You know which tool is best for which shot.

- You keep up with new AI tools and models as they’re released, and test them yourself.

- Intent-driven editing: every hook, cut and caption has a purpose across the full runtime

- Editing speed

- You actually care whether your ad performed



The details:

- Rate: $20-$30 per video

- Hours: per project and flexible to start, with room to grow into steady weekly hours

- Payment: weekly via Wise



How to apply:

- A short intro about yourself

- Links to 3 of your best edits, at least one a VSL of 2+ minutes

- At least 1 example of realistic AI video you created, with the tools you used

- Your AI workflow in 3–5 sentences: how you generate a realistic clip, and how you keep characters consistent

- The software you use and your years of experience

- Your weekly availability



Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid test edit.



Bonus points for a quick Loom video introducing yourself. It’s not required, but it stands out.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software.  Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Nice to have:

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule:   Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

 *Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

 *Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.



Application Instruction:

Fill out this form:

START DATE

ABOUT LOT DECODER

WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: Lead Generation, Cold Calling & Sales Representative – $1/Hour + 10% Commission
description:
# Job Title: UK Lead Generation, Cold Calling & Sales Representative – $1/Hour + Commission



**Company:** Sole Bookkeeping (UK)  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Position:** Part-time / Full-time  

**Target Market:** United Kingdom



## About Sole Bookkeeping



Sole Bookkeeping is a UK-based online bookkeeping business providing bookkeeping services to sole traders, self-employed individuals and small businesses throughout the UK.



Our services include monthly bookkeeping, income and expense tracking, bank reconciliations, VAT returns, Making Tax Digital support and other bookkeeping services.



We are looking for a motivated, confident and results-driven individual to help us generate leads, contact UK businesses and secure new paying clients.



## Job Responsibilities



### 1. Lead Generation

- Research UK sole traders and small businesses across all industries.

- Find potential customers who may need bookkeeping services.

- Build and maintain business contact databases.

- Collect business names, publicly available
 addresses and telephone numbers.

- Organise leads using Excel or Google Sheets.

- Remove duplicate and inaccurate records.



### 2. Cold Calling

- Make outbound calls to UK businesses.

- Introduce Sole Bookkeeping and explain our services.

- Speak confidently with business owners.

- Identify businesses that may need bookkeeping assistance.

- Handle initial questions and objections professionally.

- Follow up with interested prospects.

- Arrange appointments with potential customers.



### 3. Sales and Customer Acquisition

- Explain our bookkeeping services and subscription packages.

- Identify potential customers' bookkeeping requirements.

- Follow up quotations and enquiries.

- Encourage interested prospects to sign up to a bookkeeping subscription.

- Maintain accurate sales records.

- Work towards agreed customer acquisition targets.



## Pay and Commission



**Hourly rate: $1 USD per hour.**



**Additional commission:** Earn commission for every new customer who successfully signs up to a Sole Bookkeeping subscription.



Commission will be paid once the customer's subscription has been successfully activated and the agreed payment has been received.



The commission amount and payment arrangements will be explained and agreed with the successful applicant before employment begins.



There is an opportunity to increase your earnings through successful customer acquisition.



## Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident telephone manner.

- Previous experience in cold calling, telesales or lead generation.

- Experience contacting UK businesses is preferred.

- Good internet connection and reliable computer.

- Comfortable using Excel and Google Sheets.

- Self-motivated and target-driven.

- Able to work UK business hours.

- Professional, friendly and persistent.



Bookkeeping or accounting experience is beneficial but not essential.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years of cold calling or sales experience do you have?

2. Have you previously contacted UK businesses?

3. Are you comfortable making outbound calls to UK business owners?

4. How many calls can you realistically make per working day?

5. Have you previously sold subscriptions or monthly services?

6. What is your experience with lead generation?

7. Are you comfortable with an hourly rate of $1 USD plus commission for each successful subscription sign-up?



Please include a short example of how you would introduce our bookkeeping services to a UK business owner over the telephone.



We are looking for someone reliable, enthusiastic and interested in developing a long-term working relationship with Sole Bookkeeping.

title: Shopify Product Sourcing & Dropshipping VA
description:
Wealthy Elite Boss is looking for an experienced Shopify Product Sourcing & Dropshipping Virtual Assistant to help manage the product sourcing and backend product-management side of our ecommerce store.



This role is ideal for someone who already has hands-on experience working with Shopify and dropshipping vendors and understands how to evaluate products, organize product information, work with supplier data, and maintain a clean, accurate Shopify catalog.



You will be provided with a **fixed list of approved vendors** as well as specific product-sourcing criteria after hire.



Your primary responsibility will be to identify products from those vendors that meet our requirements, submit your selections for approval, and then upload approved products into Shopify.



We sell across multiple product categories, so you must be comfortable researching and organizing a variety of products rather than working in only one niche.



Primary Responsibilities



- Source products from our approved vendor list according to provided criteria

- Review products for quality, fit, pricing, variants, availability, images, and overall suitability

- Submit sourced products for approval before publishing them to the store

- Calculate retail pricing and profit margins using our established pricing rules

- Upload approved products into Shopify

- Properly organize:

  - Product titles

  - Images

  - Variants

  - Pricing

  - Tags

  - Collections

  - Vendor information

  - Product details

- Maintain clean and consistent product organization within Shopify

- Monitor existing products for:

  - Supplier price changes

  - Stock availability

  - Discontinued products

  - Broken or unavailable variants

  - Product-image issues

  - Incorrect pricing

- Update Shopify listings when vendor information changes

- Identify and report issues before they negatively affect the customer experience

- Keep accurate records of sourced, approved, uploaded, and unavailable products

- Follow established product-sourcing and store-management procedures

- Communicate consistently regarding product approvals, vendor issues, and store updates



What We Are Looking For



You should have **real experience working with Shopify and dropshipping vendors**.



This is not an entry-level Shopify role.



You should be comfortable navigating Shopify independently and understand the relationship between supplier information and the customer-facing product listing.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



- Shopify product management

- Dropshipping suppliers/vendors

- Product sourcing and product research

- Product variants

- Collections and tags

- Supplier pricing

- Retail pricing and margins

- Inventory monitoring

- Product availability

- Product uploads

- Backend store organization

title: Project Operations Manager
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Project Operations Manager to oversee daily operations, project schedules, employee accountability, and client deliverables within a growing professional services business.



This is a hands-on management position responsible for ensuring that work gets completed on time, employees stay on task, deadlines are met, and client commitments are fulfilled.



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, follows up relentlessly, identifies problems before they become bigger issues, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.



The primary objective is simple: Manage daily execution so the business owner does not have to manage everyone's schedules, assignments, and deliverables.



Key Responsibilities



1. Daily Project & Workflow Management



Review daily and weekly project schedules.



Assign and monitor tasks across team members.



Ensure employees understand their priorities and deadlines.



Monitor project progress and identify potential delays.



Follow up on outstanding assignments to ensure timely completion.



Keep projects moving forward and prevent work from getting stalled.



2. Team Accountability & Performance



Conduct brief daily team check-ins.



Ensure team members are completing assigned responsibilities.



Follow up on missed deadlines and incomplete assignments.



Identify employees who are falling behind or struggling with workload.



Address accountability issues directly and professionally.



Escalate recurring performance concerns to ownership.



3. Client Deliverables & Service Quality



Monitor client deliverables and ensure deadlines are met.



Track outstanding client requests and follow-up items.



Ensure projects are progressing according to agreed timelines.



Identify potential client service issues before they escalate.



Coordinate communication between team members to ensure a consistent client experience.



4. Scheduling & Capacity Management



Maintain project schedules and team calendars.



Monitor employee workloads and capacity.



Identify scheduling conflicts and resource constraints.



Coordinate the distribution of work across the team.



Ensure upcoming deadlines are anticipated and properly assigned.



5. Reporting & Operational Oversight



Maintain dashboards showing project status and outstanding tasks.



Prepare weekly operational reports for ownership.



Track completion rates, overdue projects, and employee productivity.



Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend improvements.



Ensure project management systems are consistently updated.



Daily Operating Expectations



The Project Operations Manager will establish and maintain a consistent daily operating rhythm:



Morning: Review schedules, priorities, deadlines, and employee assignments.



Daily check-in: Confirm priorities and identify obstacles.



Midday: Monitor progress and follow up on outstanding work.



End of day: Review completed assignments and identify unfinished items.



Weekly: Provide ownership with a summary of team performance, project status, overdue deliverables, and operational concerns.



Required Qualifications



3+ years of project management, operations management, or team leadership experience.



Experience managing employees or remote teams.



Strong organizational and follow-up skills.



Experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines.



Ability to hold people accountable in a professional manner.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Proficiency with project management and workflow software.



Ability to identify problems and independently drive solutions.



Experience in accounting, consulting, professional services, or other client-service businesses is highly desirable.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by:



Percentage of projects completed on schedule.



Percentage of assigned tasks completed by deadline.



Reduction in overdue client deliverables.



Employee accountability and productivity.



Accuracy and consistency of project tracking.



Timely identification and resolution of workflow issues.



Reduction in the amount of daily operational management required from ownership.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is not simply an administrator or task coordinator. We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of operations and managing people.



You should be:



Proactive rather than reactive.



Comfortable following up and holding people accountable.



Persistent about deadlines and commitments.



Organized and detail-oriented.



Confident communicating with employees and management.



Able to manage multiple projects without constant direction.



Focused on results, not just activity.



Position Structure



Position: Project Operations Manager



Engagement: Fractional / Part-Time / Potential Full-Time



Work Arrangement: Remote



Reporting To: Business Owner / Managing Partner



What Success Looks Like



The owner should no longer need to:



Chase employees for project updates.



Remind team members about deadlines.



Track every outstanding assignment.



Follow up repeatedly on client deliverables.



Resolve routine scheduling and workflow issues.



The Project Operations Manager owns daily execution, team accountability, and project progress, allowing ownership to focus on business development, client relationships, and strategic growth.

title: YouTube Channel Manager / Operations Manager

**YouTube Channel Manager / Operations Manager — Experienced Multi-Channel Operator**



**Blitz Corp | Remote | Long-term**  

**Compensation:** Based on demonstrated experience. Include your expected monthly rate and availability.



Blitz Corp  is hiring an experienced YouTube Operations Manager to oversee production and publishing across multiple channels.



We want someone who has already worked inside a functioning YouTube operation and understands how to keep writers, editors, thumbnail designers and publishing schedules moving. You should be able to explain what you personally managed, what improved because of your work, and how you measured it.



Experience with faceless, documentary, AI-assisted or AI-avatar channels is especially valuable.



**What you will own**



- Manage production from approved idea and script through editing, quality review, thumbnail, upload and scheduling.

- Coordinate writers, editors and designers; assign work, follow up and resolve bottlenecks.

- Maintain production boards, content calendars and an upcoming-video buffer.

- Review scripts, narration, visuals, thumbnails and metadata before publication.

- Preserve each channel’s style, audience and publishing requirements.

- Monitor CTR, retention, watch time and publishing consistency; recommend specific improvements.

- Track production costs, turnaround times, revisions and missed deadlines.

- Help assess new niches, formats and production tools.

- Improve SOPs, onboarding, quality checks and reporting.

- Help recruit and evaluate team members as we grow.



**Experience required**



- At least two years of hands-on YouTube production or channel-management experience.

- Experience managing at least three channels simultaneously, or equivalent responsibility within a larger network.

- Direct responsibility for coordinating creative staff and getting videos published.

- Confidence using YouTube Studio, spreadsheets and tools such as ClickUp, Trello, Asana or Notion.

- Strong English, reliable communication and good judgment when priorities conflict.

- Evidence of your actual responsibilities and results.



Experience overseeing ten or more channels, managing AI-assisted production, or turning an unreliable workflow into a dependable operation is a strong advantage.



We prioritize candidates with proven operational ownership. Courses and general social-media experience alone will not satisfy the experience requirement.



**Your first month**



Review our workflow, identify its biggest bottlenecks, establish clear ownership and deadlines, and implement practical reporting and quality control.



We want someone who improves how the business runs and can explain why a change is worth making.



**How to apply**



Use the subject:



**YouTube Operations Manager — [number of channels managed simultaneously]**



Answer these questions in order:



1. How long have you worked in YouTube operations? What is the largest number of channels you personally managed simultaneously?



2. What niches and formats did those channels cover? How many videos did the team publish weekly, and what were you personally responsible for?



3. Provide two or three relevant examples. Include channel links where permitted, or redacted production-board, calendar or analytics screenshots. Explain your contribution and when you worked on each project.



4. Describe one operational improvement you implemented. What was the problem, what did you change, and what measurable result followed?



5. Explain the production workflow you know best: who handled each stage, how handoffs worked, how quality was checked and how delays were resolved.



6. Which tools have you used for scripting, voiceovers, avatars, editing, thumbnails, project management and publishing? Distinguish tools you personally operated from tools you supervised.



7. A video is due tomorrow. The edit is late, its thumbnail is unfinished, and the next script has not been assigned. What would you do first, and how would you protect the following uploads?



8. Include your expected monthly rate, weekly availability, timezone and earliest start date.



Share experience and methods you developed or are authorized to discuss. Redacted examples are welcome; former employers’ confidential documents are not required.



**Hiring process**



Application review → practical operations interview → short paid trial using our materials.



During the interview, we will ask you to walk through your examples, explain your decisions and show how you would adapt your experience to our channels.

title: Operations Transformation Lead/Operations Builder
description:

This Is Not a Traditional Operations Role

We are not looking for someone to maintain an operation that is already fully built.

We are looking for someone who can help build it.

•	Solving operational challenges

•	Leading change and improvement initiatives

•	Driving accountability and execution

If you prefer highly structured environments where everything is already documented and defined, this role is probably not the right fit.

________________________________________

Your Mission

Work directly with ownership to help transform a founder-led service company into a scalable, system-driven organization capable of delivering operational excellence, accountability, consistency, and sustainable growth.

Over time, this role is expected to become a key leadership position within the organization, helping shape team structure, performance standards, reporting frameworks, operational governance, and the systems that support future growth.

What You'll Do

•	Partner with leadership on strategic initiatives and operational priorities

•	Help build the operational foundation required for future growth and scalability

•	Help establish scalable operational processes that support business development, client growth, and future expansion

________________________________________

What We're Looking For

Required

•	5+ years of experience in Operations, Process Improvement, Project Management, Business Transformation, Change Management, Operational Excellence, or Team Leadership

•	Experience building, designing, or improving systems and processes from scratch

•	Experience leading remote teams

•	Strong leadership — able to hold staff accountable and train new hires

•	Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities

•	High level of ownership and accountability

•	Comfortable working in an environment where not every process is already defined

Strongly Preferred

•	Experience working directly with U.S.-based teams, business owners, clients, or organizations
