________________________________________

You Will Likely Thrive Here If

•	You naturally take ownership

•	You think in processes rather than tasks

•	You can balance strategic thinking with practical execution

•	You are comfortable making decisions and driving initiatives forward

________________________________________

Important

Candidates who have only managed established processes and teams without experience building, improving, or transforming operations are unlikely to be successful in this role.

We are looking for builders, not caretakers.

________________________________________

Compensation & Growth

Starting at $1,000 USD/month.

Higher compensation may be available based on experience, leadership capability, industry expertise, and demonstrated results.

Performance bonuses and long-term advancement opportunities are available for exceptional performers.

Full-time, long-term role.

title: Project Coordinator & ClickUp Specialist (AI & Automation)
description:
// About Us //



Qontour is a boutique agency based primarily in California (USA) with a diverse, globally distributed team. We create brands, build websites, and develop marketing materials of all kinds, mainly for B2B SaaS cybersecurity companies.



Our core collaboration hours are 18:00 to 22:00 UTC, Monday through Friday. In the Philippines, that’s 2:00 to 6:00 a.m., Tuesday through Saturday. You must be available during this window for team meetings and collaboration.



// About the Role //



We’re looking for a team member to help keep client projects moving, strengthen how we use ClickUp, and improve the systems behind our work.



You’ll work closely with our project manager and content, design, and development leads to turn discussions into action, keep priorities visible, and make sure tasks and handoffs don’t fall through the cracks. You’ll also help identify and implement practical automation and AI improvements.



This is a hands-on coordination and systems role, not just task monitoring. We need someone who follows through, spots missing information, and helps resolve issues without waiting to be asked.



You don’t need to be an expert in every area listed below. Strong project coordination and ClickUp skills are the foundation; deeper automation or AI experience is a plus.



// Responsibilities //



Project coordination:

- Turn meeting notes, client feedback, and team discussions into actionable tasks with clear owners, deadlines, and next steps

- Follow up on outstanding work, missing inputs, approvals, and client dependencies

- Flag blockers, competing priorities, and resource constraints before they affect delivery

- Prepare concise project updates showing progress, next steps, and decisions needed

- Work alongside our project manager and team leads, with clearly defined ownership for the projects or workstreams you support



ClickUp management:

- Keep project plans, task statuses, priorities, dependencies, and deadlines accurate

- Improve task templates, Custom Fields, views, dashboards, and Automations where they make work easier

- Organize briefs, decisions, files, and supporting documentation so the team can find what it needs

- Identify duplicate, outdated, or unclear tasks and help keep the workspace useful

- Keep ClickUp as our source of truth, capturing relevant updates from Slack, Asana, and other tools



Scope and handoffs:

- Track requests against agreed deliverables and flag potential scope changes for approval

- Make sure content, design, development, and QA have the inputs and context needed to begin work

- Consolidate feedback into clear action items and distinguish decisions from open questions

- Track reviews, approvals, and completion criteria through to handoff

- Adapt repeatable processes to each client’s scope rather than forcing every project into the same template



Automation and AI:

- Work with the team to identify repetitive work and opportunities to improve delivery

- Help configure, test, and maintain ClickUp Automations and connected workflows

- Depending on your experience, prototype integrations or reusable AI prompts, skills, and agents

- Test improvements against real tasks, check output quality, and document limitations and failure paths

- Prioritize solutions that fit our existing tools and expand what the team can do, rather than adding software for its own sake



Documentation and adoption:

- Document current workflows before recommending changes

- Create clear SOPs, reusable templates, and short walkthroughs

- Help teammates adopt improvements and gather feedback on what is actually useful

- Keep process documentation current as tools, responsibilities, and workflows evolve



Primary tools used:

ClickUp, Slack, Asana, Google Workspace, Claude, and AirOps. You’ll also coordinate work involving Figma and Webflow. Integration and automation tools will vary by workflow.



// What We're Looking For //



The ideal candidate for this position:

- Has hands-on experience coordinating multiple projects, ideally in an agency or web production environment

- Is confident using ClickUp beyond basic task creation and can explain systems they have improved

- Takes ownership of follow-through without needing constant reminders

- Communicates clearly in written and spoken English and gives concise, useful updates

- Can distinguish an urgent request from an actual priority and knows when to escalate

- Understands how scope, dependencies, approvals, and resource availability affect delivery

- Is comfortable working with content, design, development, and QA teams

- Can improve processes without adding unnecessary complexity

- Uses AI thoughtfully and knows where human judgment, review, and approval are needed

- Is curious, adaptable, and comfortable improving systems while client work continues

- Values accountability, constructive feedback, and focusing on what’s right rather than who’s right



Additional experience that would be helpful:

- Building integrations using APIs, webhooks, or automation platforms

- Troubleshooting automation failures and managing permissions and data access

- Creating reusable AI workflows, prompts, skills, or agents

- Familiarity with Figma, Webflow, website QA, or B2B technical marketing



// Working Hours //



You must consistently overlap with our core collaboration hours of 18:00 to 22:00 UTC, Monday through Friday. For Philippine-based candidates, this means 2:00 to 6:00 a.m., Tuesday through Saturday. Outside that window, you’ll manage follow-ups and monitor relevant work and communication tools during your agreed working schedule, keeping important updates reflected in ClickUp.



Learn more about us at 
.

title: SENIOR SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR - CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE
description:
SENIOR SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR - CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE

Microsoft 365, Azure, and Google Workspace

 

Company: AlphaRidge

 

About Us:

AlphaRidge is a New York based managed IT and cybersecurity firm serving healthcare, financial services, and public sector organizations. We run an integrated Security Operations Center and Network Operations Center, and our clients operate under HIPAA, SOC 2, and comparable compliance obligations. We are a certified Minority and Women Owned Business Enterprise.

 

The Role:

This is a senior technical seat, not a support queue role. You will own the cloud platform layer of our managed services practice and act as the escalation point above our System Administrators for anything touching tenant configuration, identity, or cloud infrastructure.

 

Roughly 80 percent of our clients run Microsoft environments, so Microsoft 365 and Azure are where your depth must be strongest. The remainder run Google Workspace or mixed environments, and you will support those with the same standard of care.

 

Your shift extends our engineering day. You start with a live handoff at the end of the US business day, then carry escalations and project work through the US evening. Work handed off to you is moving again by the US team's next morning. For you, this is a normal daytime schedule, roughly 5:00 AM to 2:00 PM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday.

 

You will work as a full member of one engineering team, not as an offshore extension of it. You will hold your own client relationships and own your own projects. Our SOC and NOC handle alerting, so you are not carrying monitoring on top of engineering.

 

Key Responsibilities:

- Own configuration, hardening, and lifecycle management of client Microsoft 365 tenants: identity, conditional access, mail, collaboration, and information governance

- Design and administer Azure infrastructure: networking, compute, storage, backup and recovery, and role based access control

- Administer Google Workspace environments for the portion of our client base that runs them

- Serve as the senior escalation point for Level 2 and Level 3 cloud identity, mail flow, licensing, and workload issues

- Plan and lead tenant to tenant, cross platform, and on premises to cloud migrations, including cutover planning

- Administer endpoint management: device and application configuration, compliance policy, and modern enrollment

- Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for provisioning, reporting, and repeatable configuration

- Maintain client documentation and runbooks to an audit ready standard, and follow change control on production changes

- Mentor System Administrators and Service Desk engineers

 

Requirements:

- 6+ years in systems administration, with at least 3 years administering Microsoft 365 at tenant level

- Production Azure experience: networking, compute, backup and recovery, and role based access control

- Advanced Entra ID experience: conditional access, hybrid identity, and privileged role management

- Strong Exchange Online administration, including mail flow troubleshooting and message trace

- Proven migration delivery as a lead, not just a participant

- Intune administration across device compliance and application deployment

- Working PowerShell proficiency, including Microsoft Graph and Exchange Online modules

- Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and certificate services

- Prior experience supporting North American or other international clients at an MSP

- Excellent written and spoken English; you will be client-facing

- Working familiarity with Google Workspace administration, or the ability to reach production competence quickly

- Reliable home setup: 25+ Mbps primary internet, a backup connection, backup power, and a quiet space for client calls

 

Preferred:

- Microsoft certifications: MS-102, AZ-104, AZ-500, or SC-300

- Google Workspace Administrator certification

- Hypervisor administration (Hyper-V or VMware) and enterprise firewall experience

- Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable)



How to Apply:

Begin your application with the word LIGHTHOUSE so we know you read this posting in full. Include a PDF CV, and two or three sentences on the most complex migration you have personally led: what moved, what broke, and what you did about it.

title: SOC Analyst (Level 1–2)
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a SOC Analyst (Level 1–2) to join our Security Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for triaging security alerts, conducting in-depth investigations, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and recommending or executing remediation steps. You'll work across a modern security stack including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, FortiGate, Netskope, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM - and you'll leverage AI-assisted analysis tools (including Claude) to accelerate investigation and response.



This is a hands-on, technically rigorous role for someone who thrives on solving puzzles, communicating clearly under pressure, and constantly leveling up their security craft.



Key Responsibilities



Alert Triage & Monitoring

Monitor security alerts and events across Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365), Netskope, FortiGate firewalls, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM.

Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: validate fidelity, classify severity, assign priority, and determine whether an alert is a true positive, false positive, or benign true positive.

Acknowledge, document, and escalate alerts per defined SLAs and runbooks.

Maintain situational awareness across multiple client environments, tenants, and Azure stack workloads (AVD, Azure VMs, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure networking).



Investigation & Root Cause Analysis

Conduct detailed investigations into security i
 — pivoting across logs, endpoint telemetry, network flows, identity signals, and user activity to build a full picture of what happened.

Construct timelines of events, identify the initial access vector, lateral movement, and impact.

Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to determine the underlying conditions that allowed an i
 to occur (misconfiguration, missing control, user behavior, vulnerability, etc.).

Use Microsoft Sentinel KQL queries to hunt across log sources, build investigations, and validate hypotheses.

Leverage AI-assisted tools (including Claude) to accelerate log analysis, summarize findings, draft queries, and support investigation workflows - while maintaining analyst judgment and validation.



Response & Next Steps

Recommend and, where authorized, execute containment and remediation actions (isolating endpoints, disabling accounts, blocking IOCs at the firewall or proxy, revoking sessions, etc.).

Coordinate with Tier 3 / IR specialists and client-facing teams to hand off complex i
 with complete context.

Document clear, actionable next steps for clients — including technical remediation, policy changes, user education, and follow-up validation.

Produce concise, professional i
 write-ups suitable for both technical and non-technical client audiences.



Continuous Improvement

Tune detection rules and analytics in Sentinel and Defender to reduce false positives and improve signal quality.

Contribute to and maintain SOC runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.

Identify recurring i
 patterns and recommend systemic improvements (control gaps, configuration drift, training opportunities).

Stay current on threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to client environments.



Required Qualifications

Experience: 1–3+ years in a SOC, NOC with security responsibilities, MSP/MSSP, IT security, or similar hands-on role.

SIEM: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including writing and tuning KQL queries.

Microsoft Security Stack: Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, O365) and Azure AD / Entra ID.

Azure: Familiarity with Azure stack components — Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Azure VMs, Azure networking, and core IAM concepts.

Network Security: Practical experience reading FortiGate firewall logs, policies, and traffic flows.

Endpoint & Cloud Tools: Exposure to Netskope (SWG/CASB), ObserveIT (or similar UAM/insider risk), NinjaRMM (or comparable RMM), and Auvik (or comparable network monitoring).

Investigation Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform structured triage, root cause analysis, and produce clear i
 documentation.

Foundations: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), authentication protocols, common attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK), and Windows event logs.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication — able to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Mindset: Curiosity, attention to detail, and the discipline to follow process without losing the ability to think critically.



Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-900, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent.

Experience in an MSP or MSSP environment supporting multiple client tenants.

Scripting / automation experience (PowerShell, Python, KQL functions, Logic Apps, Sentinel playbooks).

Experience integrating or working with AI-assisted security tooling (e.g., Claude, Security Copilot) for investigation and reporting workflows.

Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, EDR forensic workflows, and basic malware triage.

Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, SOC 2).



What You'll Get

A modern, well-instrumented security stack with real depth across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud.

Direct exposure to a wide variety of environments and i
 types — accelerated growth vs. a single-enterprise SOC.

Access to AI-assisted tooling that augments (not replaces) your analytical work.

Clear mentorship from senior analysts and a defined progression path from Tier 1 to Tier 2 and beyond.

Support for certifications and ongoing training.



Working Conditions

This role may include shift work or on-call rotation to support SOC coverage requirements.

Remote, hybrid, or onsite arrangements per AlphaRidge policy.

AlphaRidge is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Cold Caller / Property Acquisition Specialist
description:

Your main objective will be to identify potential property opportunities, build relationships, generate interest and secure opportunities for us to grow our property portfolio.

- **Extremely confident:** Comfortable speaking to landlords, agents and senior decision-makers.

- **Driven and competitive:** Motivated by targets, performance and winning deals.

- **Excellent at objection handling:** Someone who doesn't crumble when they hear "no" and knows how to turn conversations around professionally.

- **Persistent:** Willing to follow up, build relationships and pursue opportunities.

- **Hardworking and dedicated:** Someone who takes ownership of their work and consistently puts in the effort.

- **Passionate about sales:** Someone who enjoys cold calling and has the confidence to pick up the phone every day.

We offer an additional **$100 incentive for every successful property secured through your efforts**, subject to agreed attribution and successful completion of the deal.



Your performance can directly contribute to the growth of our business, and we want to reward the people who help make that happen.



 What We Want From You



We're looking for someone with a winner's mentality.



Someone who:

- Isn't afraid of rejection.

- Knows how to communicate confidently and professionally.

- Can think on their feet.

- Knows how to handle difficult conversations.

- Can speak to decision-makers and build trust.

- Is motivated by results and takes pride in securing deals.

I have reviewed the listing and would like to clarify their current availability, as well as a few details regarding the properties"



The Opportunity



We're at the beginning of an exciting growth journey, and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of building something ambitious.

If you have the confidence to pick up the phone, the resilience to handle rejection and the determination to secure deals, apply now.

title: Platform & IT Lead
description:
PLATFORM & IT LEAD (Senior Platform Engineer / Team Lead: Cloud, DevOps, IT) - 1-Year Contract, Remote



Type of work: Independent contractor, 1-year contract (a full time engagement, about 40 hours a week), renewable by mutual agreement

Contract rate: PHP 220,
,000 a month, depending on experience

Hours: Flexible, with at least 4 hours a day overlapping US business hours (Eastern / Pacific), plus a shared on-call rotation





ABOUT KILO



Kilo builds software for gyms and fitness businesses: scheduling, payments, a member app and marketing tools, used by more than a thousand gym locations. We are a small, remote engineering team that ships every week.





ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a hands-on lead role with three parts:



1. Individual contributor (about 60% of your time). You design, build and run Kilo's cloud platform yourself: cloud (today AWS) and Cloudflare infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, and production security.

2. Team lead. You lead a small team of platform and IT engineers: you set priorities, review their work, coach them, run the on-call rotation, and hire as the team grows.

3. IT for the whole company. You own company IT: identity and access, SaaS tools, security policy, and the standards for internal tools that other teams build.



You report to engineering leadership and work closely with our application developers (Django and React) and with the business teams who depend on IT.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



Platform (hands-on)

- Run and improve our production (today on AWS), staging and lower environments (ECS, EC2 Auto Scaling, ALB, RDS PostgreSQL / Aurora Serverless v2, SQS, SNS, S3, CloudFront, Lambda, EventBridge, EFS, VPC, Route 53, ACM).

- Manage infrastructure as code (we use Terraform and Packer; we will help you learn them if you have used similar tools).

- Own CI/CD in GitHub Actions: builds, tests (Playwright, Codecov, Storybook), container images (ECR) and deployments.

- Manage Cloudflare: DNS, WAF, Zero Trust (Tunnel, Access, Gateway, WARP), Workers, Workers KV, R2 and Cloudflare for SaaS.

- Own observability and alerting (SigNoz, Elastic Cloud, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Zenduty, Slack integrations).

- Lead production security: IAM and least privilege, GitHub OIDC, KMS, Secrets Manager, SSM Parameter Store and Session Manager, CloudTrail, and vulnerability fixes from Aikido, 
v and Dependabot.

- Investigate abnormal traffic and i
, write the post-i
 review and fix the root cause.

- Watch and reduce cloud spend (AWS Budgets, Cost Explorer).

- Keep the platform reliable for the Python 3.11 / Django + DRF and React + TypeScript + Vite applications (Docker, Docker Compose), and for our integrations: Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid, Hookdeck, GoHighLevel, Google Calendar, Mixpanel, WodUp, Metabase, Notion and FastMCP.



Team leadership

- Lead a small team of platform and IT engineers: weekly priorities, code and change reviews, one-on-ones and feedback.

- Run the on-call rotation and i
 process, so production does not depend on any single person.

- Write the runbooks and documentation the team works from.

- Help hire and onboard new team members.

- Report progress, risks and costs to engineering leadership each week.



Company IT

- Own identity and access for the whole company: IAM Identity Center (SSO), 1Password, Doppler, two-factor authentication, and joiner/leaver checklists so access is granted and removed on time.

- Run regular access reviews across the cloud provider, GitHub, Cloudflare and business tools.

- Administer and consolidate company SaaS tools and licenses, and keep software costs under control.

- Write and maintain IT and security policies, including acceptable use.

- Set the standards for internal tools and automations built by non-engineering teams (including AI-assisted, "vibe coded" apps): where they run, how they handle data and secrets, and how they are reviewed. Treat those teams as stakeholders in IT's requirements.

- Be the escalation point for company IT and security questions.





REQUIREMENTS



- 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, with at least 4 years running production workloads on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). We run on AWS today; experience on another cloud is fine.

- 2+ years leading engineers (team lead, tech lead or manager), including reviewing their work and running on-call.

- Hands-on experience with containers in production (ECS, Kubernetes, Cloud Run or similar), managed PostgreSQL, cloud networking, load balancers and IAM.

- CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

- Production monitoring, alerting and i
 response.

- Company IT experience: SSO, password and secrets management, onboarding and offboarding, SaaS administration.

- Solid security practice: least privilege, secrets management, patching CVEs, audit logs, written policies.

- Comfortable reading and debugging Python / Django applications.

- Excellent written English. Most of our work is written: pull requests, tickets, policies and Slack.

- Reliable internet and power backup.





NICE TO HAVE



- Cloudflare Zero Trust, WAF and Workers.

- SigNoz, Elastic or OpenTelemetry.

- Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool (CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible).

- Packer, Lambda and EventBridge.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience (Cloudflare for SaaS, custom domains).

- Security frameworks or audits (SOC 2, ISO 27001) or preparing a company for due diligence.

- AWS experience specifically, or cloud certifications (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).

- Experience using AI coding tools in your daily work, and setting rules for others who use them.





WHAT WE OFFER



- A 1-year independent contractor agreement with a stable US company, renewable by mutual agreement.

- A monthly contract rate of PHP 220,
,000, depending on experience.

- A lead role with real ownership: you shape the platform, the team and company IT.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. A link to your resume (Google Drive or Dropbox, shared so "anyone with the link" can view) or to your LinkedIn profile, pasted in your message. Please do not send attachments. Applications without a link will not be read.

2. A short description (5-10 sentences) of the most complex cloud environment you have built or run: what it was, what you owned, and one problem you solved.

3. A short description (3-5 sentences) of a team you have led: its size, what you were responsible for, and one thing you changed.

The designer must be available to provide prompt, real-time design support during these scheduled appointments.



Our required availability window extends from 9:00 AM Eastern Time to 7:00 PM Pacific Time (10:00 PM Eastern).



This does not mean you will be actively working throughout that entire period. However, you must have the flexibility to accommodate scheduled appointments within this window and be ready to make immediate design adjustments when needed.



We cannot have sales representatives sitting with customers waiting hours for design revisions. Reliability, communication, and the ability to respond quickly during scheduled appointments are essential.



Key Responsibilities



• Create accurate, optimized residential solar designs using Aurora Solar.

• Analyze sun paths, seasonal solar angles, shading, and annual production.

• Evaluate trees and obstructions, including determining which trees materially affect production and whether removal would improve system performance.

• Understand how sunrise, sunset, roof orientation, pitch, and seasonal changes impact solar production.

• Identify when Aurora’s automated calculations, imagery, shading analysis, or recommendations may be inaccurate.

• Evaluate multiple panel layouts to maximize production, system efficiency, and available roof space.

• Understand the relationship between panel orientation, shading, electrical configuration, and energy output.

• Troubleshoot unusual scenarios independently instead of relying solely on software-generated answers.

• Recognize potential design problems before they result in incorrect proposals, change orders, or installation complications.

• Communicate findings clearly and explain the reasoning behind design recommendations.

• Provide timely revisions and live design support during scheduled sales appointments.



Required Qualifications



• Extensive, hands-on experience with Aurora Solar — mandatory.

• Advanced understanding of residential photovoltaic system design and production modeling.

• Strong knowledge of solar azimuth, tilt, sun-path analysis, irradiance, and seasonal shading.

• Ability to interpret satellite imagery, LiDAR data, and roof geometry.

• Experience evaluating tree shading, tree removal scenarios, and resulting production improvements.

• Strong analytical reasoning, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving skills.

• Ability to question software outputs when results don’t make physical or technical sense.

• Familiarity with common residential solar equipment, system configurations, and electrical design considerations.

• Reliable communication and availability for scheduled, time-sensitive design revisions.



The Type of Person We’re Looking For



We value intelligence, sound judgment, and problem-solving ability as much as software experience.



Someone can be extremely fast and proficient in Aurora but still lack the fundamental understanding needed to make good solar design decisions.



We want someone who:



• Understands the science behind solar production.

• Thinks critically instead of blindly trusting software.

• Can identify problems that weren’t explicitly pointed out.

• Knows when a tree matters, when it doesn’t, and why.

• Understands the difference between a design that looks good and one that will actually perform well.

• Can explain their decisions using logic and data.

• Works independently with minimal supervision.

• Can prioritize urgent revisions when a salesperson is meeting with a customer.



Technical Assessment



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical Aurora Solar design assessment involving multiple roof planes, surrounding trees, shading complications, and competing design options.



Candidates must explain not only what they designed, but why they made each decision, including how they evaluated shading, production, and potential tree removal.



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to basic panel placement and generating proposals. We are looking for a solar design specialist with advanced analytical capabilities who is also dependable and responsive when our sales team needs support.

2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.)  High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.)  Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.)  Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.)  Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume  & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

title: Sales & Operational Manager - Virtual Assistant (Housekeeping Business)
description:
We are a growing U.S. based cleaning and housekeeping company specializing in short-term rental turnovers, including Airbnb properties. We help property owners and hosts maintain consistent cleaning quality, reliable scheduling, and an excellent guest and client experience.



We are looking for a dependable, organized, and proactive Sales and Operations Manager to help manage daily operations, coordinate our cleaning team, communicate with clients, and generate new business.



This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, solves problems independently, and wants to grow alongside a developing business.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Sales and Business Development



- Respond to inbound calls,
s, messages, and cleaning inquiries, converting qualified leads into paying customers.

- Make outbound calls and send messages to potential clients, including short-term rental hosts and property managers.

- Generate new leads through social media engagement, cold outreach, referrals, and other organic sales efforts.

- Follow up with prospective and existing clients to build relationships and secure new business.

- Track leads, sales activity, conversion rates, and follow-ups in the company's CRM or tracking systems.

- Provide accurate information about services, answer questions, and confidently communicate the value of GuestMaids.

- Work toward a target sales close rate of 40% or higher.



2. Operations and Customer Service



- Coordinate daily and weekly cleaning schedules to ensure all jobs are assigned and completed on time.

- Communicate with cleaners, monitor progress, and address scheduling needs.

- Handle last-minute cancellations, cleaner call-outs, no-shows, and other operational issues.

- Respond promptly (within 10 minutes) to client inquiries, requests, schedule changes, and minor complaints.

- Monitor ongoing cleaning jobs and ensure reported issues and follow-ups are resolved.

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date schedules in our booking software.

- Monitor cleaner performance and escalate significant issues to the owner when necessary.

- Maintain professional communication with clients, cleaners, and other team members.



3. Cleaner Recruitment and Onboarding



- Maintain and update job descriptions and online job listings for cleaner positions.

- Review applications, communicate with candidates, and conduct initial interviews.

- Assist with recruiting, selecting, and onboarding reliable cleaners.

- Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline to support the company's growth.

- Help ensure new cleaners understand company expectations, cleaning standards, and operational procedures.



4. Marketing and Online Presence



- Manage and update the company's social media accounts.

- Maintain the company's Google Business Profile, including posting updates and responding to reviews.

- Update website content and assist with improving the website's appearance, usability, and search engine optimization (SEO).

- Help develop practical marketing strategies to attract new clients and strengthen the company's online presence.



5. Administrative and Special Projects



- Maintain accurate client records, sales information, schedules, and other business documentation.

- Complete assigned business and administrative tasks within established deadlines.

- Assist with process improvements, documentation (i.e. SOP), and projects that improve operational efficiency.

- Take ownership of assigned tasks and provide updates on progress and outstanding issues.

- Assist with other reasonable business or administrative tasks as needed.



Requirements and Qualifications:



- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Previous experience in sales, customer service, virtual assistance, operations, or administrative support.

- Comfortable making outbound calls, following up with leads, and selling services over the phone or through messages.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle unexpected situations calmly.

- Comfortable using computers, spreadsheets, online platforms, and business software.

- Willingness to learn and use tools such as Notion, ConvertLabs, Breezeway, CRM systems, scheduling software, and website management platforms.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

- A proactive mindset: able to identify problems, suggest solutions, and take action without waiting for instructions on every task.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for professional remote work.

- Ability to work effectively in a growing business where priorities and responsibilities may change.



Preferred Qualifications:



- Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

- Experience in the cleaning, housekeeping, Airbnb, or property management industry.

- Experience recruiting and coordinating cleaners or independent contractors.

- Familiarity with social media management, Google Business Profile, website editing, and basic SEO.



Work Schedule:



- Part-time or Full-time position, with the initial schedule agreed upon with the successful candidate.

- Working hours will be coordinated around U.S. Eastern Time (8:30AM to 5:30PM)

- Availability during agreed-upon working hours is important to ensure timely responses to clients and cleaners.



Compensation and Bonuses:



* **Base pay:** Hourly compensation, agreed upon before starting.

* **Payment schedule:** Biweekly payments through Wise.

* **Monthly KPI bonus:** An additional 5% of the month's base pay if all established monthly key performance indicators (KPIs) are met.

* **New revenue bonus:** 1% of new revenue booked. For example, booking $1,000 in new business earns a $10 bonus.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by the following:



Scheduling and reliability: Cleaning jobs are assigned and completed as scheduled, with minimal errors or delays.

Customer service: Client inquiries and messages receive a response within 10 minutes during working hours, whenever reasonably possible.

Customer satisfaction: Clients and guests consistently receive the high-quality service expected from GuestMaids.

Cleaner coordination: Cleaners receive clear communication, feel supported, and have the information needed to complete their assignments successfully.

Sales performance: Maintain a target close rate of 40% or higher for qualified sales leads.

Lead management: Keep sales records updated and ensure prospective clients receive timely follow-ups.

Task completion: Complete assigned responsibilities accurately and within established deadlines.



Work Leave and Communication Expectations:



- Requests for more than two consecutive days off should be submitted at least seven days in advance.

- Other planned time-off requests should be submitted at least 48 hours in advance.

- If leaving the position, the employee is expected to provide at least 14 days' notice.

- Maintain professional communication and notify the owner promptly about absences, delays, or issues affecting work.



Technical Requirements:



- A dedicated workstation at home.

- A stable internet connection of at least 30 Mbps.

- A backup internet solution and access to backup devices or power arrangements when needed.

- A quiet working environment suitable for calls and professional communication.



How to Apply?



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself and why you are the best candidate for this role? Please send your video to 



We care about more than getting tasks done. We want to build a team of people we can trust to do the right thing, care about others, and take ownership of their work.



Our values guide how we make decisions, communicate, and serve our customers. We’re looking for someone who genuinely identifies with these values and demonstrates them through their daily actions.



1. Excellence

Do the Job Right, Even When No One Is Watching.



We take pride in our work and pay attention to the details. We don't cut corners or wait for someone to check our work. Whether you're updating a cleaning schedule, responding to a customer, following up with a lead, or completing an administrative task, you take responsibility for doing it correctly.



2. Honest and Fair

Tell the Truth and Treat People Right.



We communicate honestly, take responsibility for mistakes, and treat customers, cleaners, and teammates fairly. If something goes wrong, we address it instead of hiding it. We value people who can be trusted to give accurate updates, keep their commitments, and do the right thing even when it's uncomfortable.



3. Care About People

Look Out for Our Customers and Each Other.



Our business depends on trust and strong relationships. We want someone who genuinely cares about helping customers, supporting cleaners, and making things easier for the people they work with. You listen, show empathy, communicate respectfully, and look for solutions that are fair and practical.



4. Always Growing

Keep Learning and Getting Better.



We don't expect you to know everything from day one. We do expect you to be curious, open to feedback, and willing to improve. You learn from mistakes, look for better ways to do things, and take initiative to develop your skills. As GuestMaids grows, we want you to grow with us.



5. Go With the Flow

Adapt Without Losing Your Cool.



Cleaning operations can change quickly. A cleaner might cancel, a customer might change a schedule, or an urgent issue might need attention. We need someone who can adjust priorities, stay calm under pressure, and focus on solving the problem rather than getting frustrated. We value flexibility, practical thinking, and a positive approach to change.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities. You don't need someone reminding you about every task or telling you what to do at every step. You notice what needs attention, communicate when something is wrong, and follow through until the job is done.



You care about the quality of your work, treat people fairly, and understand that small details can make a big difference to customers and the team.



We're looking for someone who wants to be part of a growing business, contribute ideas, solve problems, and build systems that help the company run better over time.



If these values reflect how you naturally work, not just what you think an employer wants to hear, we'd like to meet you!

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:

About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth; with over 5 remote employees.



The Role



We're looking for a part-time Customer Support Specialist to handle customer escalations in the evenings and on weekends.



Our AI handles the first reply to most customer questions. You step in where a human is needed: approving refunds and replacements, solving issues the AI can't, and making sure every customer leaves happy. You'll also help the AI improve by flagging wrong answers and suggesting better ones. This is a focused, part-time role.



You're the right person if:



- Enjoy solving customer problems and turning an unhappy customer into a loyal one

- Can work through a queue quickly without losing accuracy

- Notice when something is wrong (a bad AI answer, a pattern of complaints) and raise it without being asked

- Want to learn how AI customer support works, and help shape it



This is not for you if:



- You want a full-time role. This is about 14 hours a week

- You are uncomfortable learning new software tools and AI on your own

- You cannot reliably work evenings (10pm–12am PHT) and weekends

- Your written English is not natural and professional, since most of our customers are in the US.



What you will do:



- Escalation handling: resolve customer conversations the AI has passed to a human, across
, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger and TikTok Shop

- Approvals: review and approve refunds, replacements and other resolutions, following our authority framework

- Order look-ups: check orders, tracking and subscriptions in Shopify, Amazon and our subscription app

- AI quality review: check AI replies, flag errors

- Handover: leave clear notes for the morning team on anything still open



What We Are Looking For:



- at least 1+ years in customer support for an e-commerce or consumer brand (US customers a plus)

- Experience with a helpdesk tool (Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar)

- Familiarity with Shopify is a plus



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Ownership: when I close my shift, the queue is clear or handed over properly

- Good judgment: I know when to follow the rule and when to escalate

- Curious: I want to understand why customers write in, not just answer them

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way



Details



This is a part-time remote role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP
per hour



Commitment: about 14 hours a week:

- 4 weeknights, 10:00pm–12:00am Philippines Time (2 hours each)

- Saturday and Sunday, 3 hours each (time to be agreed)

- Enjoy comparing results, spotting patterns and testing small changes to see what improves

- Can juggle dozens of creator conversations across DMs,
 and WhatsApp without letting anyone slip through the cracks

- Follow up and push things forward rather than wait to be told what's next

- Learn fast and pick up new tools (including AI) on your own



Do not apply if:



- You mainly see yourself as a creative and want to make your own content. This role is about analysing and improving content, not creating it.

- You don't use TikTok or Instagram regularly yourself

- You are uncomfortable being a project manager or following up with people who go quiet

- Your written English is not clear and professional. You will be writing to creators on our behalf.



What You'll Do



- Creator Sourcing: find and reach out to creators whose audience matches ours (women aged 25–35 who are into wellness, pilates and healthy routines)

- Affiliate Management: onboard creators, send free product, agree on terms and keep every creator moving from "interested" to "posted"

- Content Briefing: write clear briefs based on what has actually worked for us and what is trending right now

- Content Review: review creator content before it goes live and give specific feedback to improve it

- Performance Analysis: track how every post performs (views, clicks, sales), work out what the winners have in common, and feed that back into the next briefs

- Trend Watching: spot formats and trends we should test, and back up your suggestions with examples of how they are performing



What We Are Looking For



Skills:



- Strong understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and what makes people buy

- Organised: comfortable keeping trackers in Google Sheets or similar

- Clear, friendly written English

- Comfortable with tech tools and AI

- Bonus (not required): experience with influencer outreach, product gifting



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Urgency and ownership: today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done

- Proactive communicator: if something might go wrong, I flag it early

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way, and I back it up with evidence





Details



This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 75,000 per month



Commitment: Contract role with the option to extend if found to be suitable

Hours: Philippine business hours, Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm, with flexibility to reply to creators outside these hours

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads | DTC Skincare | Up to $1,000 Per Winning Ad

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:

title: Social Media Content Assistant / Video Editor
description:
Allegra Bakes is a New York-based children’s baking and education brand. We create baking experiences, workshops, books and products that help children build confidence, independence and creativity through baking.



 We’re looking for a creative, organized and detail-oriented Social Media Content Assistant to help us turn our existing photos and videos into engaging content for Instagram and TikTok.



We have plenty of footage, photographs and content ideas. We need someone who can take these materials and turn them into polished, ready-to-publish posts.



This is a content creation and editing role, not a social media strategy position.



Key Responsibilities



Video Editing



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

* Turn raw baking footage into engaging 15–45-second videos.

* Add appropriate music, text overlays, captions and transitions.

* Repurpose existing videos into multiple pieces of content.

* Create engaging videos that capture attention without excessive effects or editing.



Social Media Content



* Design Instagram carousels and static posts using existing photographs.

* Create Instagram Stories to promote workshops, products and events.

* Draft short, engaging captions that match our brand voice.

* Follow established brand guidelines, including fonts, colors and visual style.



Content Management



* Maintain a simple social media content calendar.

* Organize photos, videos and finished content in Google Drive.

* Prepare and schedule posts for approval.

* Track content progress and meet agreed deadlines.



Content Expectations



Initially, we’re aiming to produce:



* 3–4 Instagram feed posts per week (primarily Reels and carousels).

* 3–5 Instagram Stories per week.

* Repurposed Reels for TikTok.

* A simple, organized weekly content calendar.



Our longer-term goal is to publish daily as we establish an efficient workflow.



Required Skills



* Proven experience editing Instagram Reels and TikTok videos.

* Proficiency in CapCut or similar video editing software.

* Experience creating graphics and carousels in Canva.

* Strong visual design skills and attention to detail.

* Excellent written English.

* Ability to follow creative direction and brand guidelines.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently.

* Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has a strong eye for clean, modern and visually engaging content.

* Understands Instagram and TikTok trends.

* Enjoys creating content for food, baking, lifestyle or family-focused brands.

* Can work creatively with existing footage rather than needing everything planned out.

* Is proactive, organized and comfortable working independently.

* Is interested in a long-term working relationship.



Experience creating content for food, baking, children’s brands or small businesses would be a bonus.



Hours & Compensation



* Approximately 10 hours per week to start.

* $6–8 USD per hour, depending on experience.

* Flexible working hours.

* Potential to increase hours as the brand grows.

* Long-term opportunity for the right person.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio: Links to Instagram Reels or TikTok videos you’ve personally edited.

2. Design examples: Two or three Instagram carousels or graphics you’ve created.

3. Tools: Your experience with CapCut, Canva and social media scheduling tools.

4. Availability: Your preferred working hours and availability per week.

5. Rate: Your expected hourly rate.



Paid editing assignment - Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid editing assignment using our existing footage.



Overall you’ll have plenty of creative material to work with, clear brand guidelines and the opportunity to help shape how our content looks as the business grows.

title: US Tax Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a growing accounting and advisory practice based in the San Francisco Bay Area, in the heart of the AI industry and Silicon Valley.  We serve small businesses, professional practices and their owners. We are looking for a US Tax Manager in the Philippines to lead our tax function: reviewing returns, guiding clients on planning, and building a small team of preparers. Bookkeeping duties will also be added to the role.



This is a long-term, full-time independent contractor role. You work with us directly, not through an agency or outsourcing company. You report to the firm owner and are the senior technical voice on US tax.



Location: Remote, Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor, 40 hours per week

Start: As soon as possible, ahead of the 2027 filing season



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Review and sign off on US federal and state returns: 1040, 1065, 1120, 1120-S and 1041, including multi-state filings

- Prepare complex returns yourself where needed, such as entity returns with K-1s, depreciation schedules and basis tracking

- Advise clients and the firm owner on tax planning: entity choice, S-corp reasonable compensation, retirement plans, estimated payments and year-end moves

- Research technical questions and write clear memos with citations to the Code, regulations and IRS guidance

- Handle IRS and state notices, and prepare responses for review

- Build and run the tax workflow: checklists, review standards, deadline tracking and extension management

- Hire, train and review the work of 1 to 3 tax preparers as the practice grows

- Work with the bookkeeping team so client books are tax-ready at year end

- Take on bookkeeping duties as they are added: monthly bank and credit card reconciliations, accruals and adjusting entries, month-end close and financial statements in QuickBooks Online or Xero



WHAT YOU NEED

- Licensed Philippine CPA, a US CPA, or a US Enrolled Agent (EA)

- 7+ years of hands-on US tax preparation and review, with at least 3 years as a reviewer, supervisor or manager

- Experience working for, or directly with, US CPA firms

- Strong command of individual and pass-through returns, and working knowledge of C-corp and fiduciary returns

- Comfort with at least one professional tax program: CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect or Drake

- Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online or Xero

- Excellent written and spoken English; you will talk with US clients directly

- A reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, backup power and a private workspace

- An active PTIN, or willingness to get one before you start



NICE TO HAVE

- Both a Philippine CPA license and a US EA credential

- California tax experience (FTB Forms 540, 565, 568 and 100S)

- Experience with dental, medical or other professional practices

- Real estate tax experience: rental properties, 1031 exchanges, cost segregation

- Experience with tax season workflow tools such as Karbon, TaxDome or Canopy

- Prior experience building or leading an offshore tax team



HOURS:

40 per week, with at least 4 hours overlapping US Pacific business hours (9 AM–5 PM PT)



BUSY SEASON:

Extra hours from February to April and around the September and October extension deadlines, paid at your hourly rate



PAY:

50,000 - 80,000 PHP monthly salary, based on credentials and experience



PAID TIME OFF:

10 days per year plus Philippine regular holidays, scheduled outside busy season



TRIAL PERIOD:

90 days, including a paid trial review project



EQUIPMENT

You provide your own computer; we provide tax software, practice management tools and a secure remote environment



CONFIDENTIALITY

You sign a contractor agreement and NDA, and follow our data security rules. No client data on personal devices.



HOW TO APPLY:

- Send the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.

- Your resume, listing each US tax role with dates, firm type and the return types you prepared or reviewed

- Your PRC license number, EA enrollment number or US CPA license number, so we can verify it

- A short note (under 200 words) on the most complex return you have reviewed and what you caught

- Which tax software you have used, and for how many seasons

- Your expected monthly rate in PHP

- Begin your message with the words "Pass-through review" so we know you read this posting



OUR PROCESS:

- Application review and credential check

- 30-minute video call with the firm owner

- Paid technical exercise: review a sample 1120-S and 1040 with planted errors (about 3 hours)

- Final call and reference check with a US firm you have worked for

- Offer and contractor agreement

title: Senior Email Deliverability Engineer & Outbound Systems Architect
description:
Senior Email Deliverability Engineer & Outbound Systems Architect



THIS IS NOT AN
 MARKETING JOB. THIS IS INFRASTRUCTURE.



We will be sending 200k–1M outbound emails/week across multiple domains and ESPs. You will architect, operate, and scale the entire system with precision.



If you have not personally built deliverability infrastructure from zero ? scale, you will not succeed here.



IMPORTANT: If your experience is team-level, agency-level, or tool-assisted (Instantly presets, Smartlead presets), you will not pass the assessment. We are hiring someone who has personally built, tested, and repaired systems — not someone who "used a tool."



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Full-stack outbound ecosystem:



150k–500k mixed warm/cold lists (70% Gmail)

Multi-domain + multi-ESP sending architecture

DNS engineering (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI)

Domain/IP warmup schedules + reputation management

List segmentation, list cleaning, bounce/complaint management

Deliverability testing + seed monitoring

ESP orchestration (Instantly, Smartlead, Mailgun/SES/SendGrid)

CRM and workflow integration (
, n8n)

Daily performance reporting: inbox rate, domain reputation, spam/trap indicators

Emergency triage when inbox placement drops



Your mandate: Maintain ?50% inbox placement at high volume and scale sending without triggering reputation loss, throttling, or domain burnouts.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (Non-negotiable)

You must have hands-on experience doing all of the following:



3+ years owning outbound systems sending 100k–1M+ emails/week

Built multi-domain / multi-ESP sending systems from scratch

Personally configured SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, tracking domains

Designed and executed domain warmups (new ? warmed ? rotation ? retirement)

Deep practical understanding of Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo filtering systems

Diagnosed and fixed inbox placement drops (Gmail Tabs, spam placement, throttling, IP reputation collapse, blocklist triggers)

Experience with: Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Mailgun, Amazon SES, SendGrid

Automation integrations (
, n8n, Zapier)



Ability to interpret and act on:



Gmail Postmaster Tools

Microsoft SNDS

Spamhaus/Spamcop signals

Seed test results (GlockApps, Folderly, InboxAlly)



Can explain, in technical detail, the difference between:



Reputation-based filtering

Content-based filtering

Engagement-based filtering

Heuristic vs. ML filtering (Gmail)



If you cannot explain this clearly, you will not pass the assessment.

If you've only worked on customer lists or relied on platform defaults, this role is not for you.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Do not apply if:



Your largest volume was under 50k/week

You've never built a multi-domain system

You rely on tutorials, agencies, or platform presets

You've never run a domain warmup schedule yourself

You think deliverability = "avoid spam words"

You've never fixed a Gmail reputation crash

You cannot explain why inbox placement drops and what root factors caused it

You've only sent to fully-warm or opt-in lists

You need supervision or detailed task instructions

You cannot produce proof of past sending volume (e.g., Postmaster screenshots, ESP dashboards, warmup logs)



TO APPLY

Include in your application:



Total years managing 100k+/week volume

Largest weekly send you've personally operated

One deliverability crisis you diagnosed and recovered from (4-5 sentences: what broke, root cause, your fix, outcome)

Tools/platforms you've used at scale

Screenshot of a sending system you personally operated (any ESP: volume view, reputation metrics, Postmaster Tools, or SNDS)



Applications missing this information will not be reviewed.



HIRING PROCESS

Step 1: Application review

Step 2: Technical assessment (90 min — architecture design + diagnostics)

Step 3: Technical interview (60 min)

Step 4: Reference checks



Only candidates who pass the technical assessment will be interviewed.



Must have: at minimum moden high performance computer, dual 24" or better monitors, high quality headset with boom mic, HD reliable webcam, and reliable redundant high-speed internet

title: In-House Short-Form Video Editor / Content Clipper (Fully Remote)
